Title: Staff Data Scientist (Forecasting)
Description:
The problem

Every week, a tomato grower tells their buyers how many kilos they’ll deliver three weeks from now. Contracts, trucks, and prices are set on that number. Source builds AI software that greenhouse growers in Europe and North America use for decisions like this, and our Harvest Forecast for tomato, pepper, and cucumber is one of the inputs to that weekly number.

Getting an average week right isn’t the hard part. The value is in the weeks when the crop does something unusual: a heat wave, a sharp drop after a peak, the start and end of the season. Those are the weeks when growers need a forecast most, and when forecasts, ours included, are trusted least.

Why this is hard:


Slow feedback. You can replay past seasons with any model. But a new model in production shows its first real result only three to four weeks later, and the weeks that matter come only a few times a year. You can’t A/B test a crop.
Thin, noisy data. A few plants, measured by hand once or twice a week, stand in for a whole greenhouse. Sensors drift. Every site, variety, and grower strategy is a little different.
Not all of it is biology. Part of every swing comes from the plant, and part from decisions the grower makes after the forecast is made. Telling the two apart is part of the job.
Strong science, messy greenhouses. Decades of crop and climate science exist. Data alone won’t rediscover it, and the science alone doesn’t fit a real greenhouse.
People act on the number. A forecast that’s confidently wrong costs a grower real money, so the uncertainty has to be honest.



We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist who has done this before: taken a forecast of a physical system that people didn’t trust, and turned it into a number a business commits money on.

The difficulty isn’t one clever model. It’s the whole system: data quality, how plants are sampled, growers changing their harvest plans, and then the model. There may be ten things to fix before the forecast is good, and only some of them are in the model. You look at the whole system end to end, find the places that matter, do the hardest work yourself, and carry it all the way to something growers use.

This is a senior individual contributor role, technical all the way, with no people management. You report to our Director of Engineering and join our staff engineers, the senior group that works across teams with the CTO and sets the technical bar. Day-to-day, you work with our data scientists, crop scientists, and directly with growers. Harvest forecasting is the first problem. The same kind of problem shows up across our other crop models, and we expect your work to reach those too.

The role is based in Amsterdam, because you can’t see the whole system from a distance. You need to be in the room with the data scientists, the crop scientists and the people who talk to growers every week.

What You’ll Do


Own the accuracy of our harvest forecasts for tomato, pepper and cucumber, especially in the unusual weeks, from diagnosis to a fix growers use
Decide which problem is worth solving first, including when the fix is in the input data, the plant sampling, or the grower’s plan rather than the model
Design and build hybrid models that combine crop physiology and greenhouse climate with statistical and machine learning methods
Build the evaluation backbone: backtests on past seasons, strong baselines, uncertainty calibration, and production monitoring, so the next ten fixes get cheaper
Ship your models to production with our engineers, and stay responsible for how they behave there
Raise the bar of the data science team through review, challenge, and mentoring



We care most about what you’ve done. Today you might be called a data scientist, forecasting scientist, ML scientist, quant, or research engineer. The title doesn’t matter to us.


Around 10 years of hands-on modelling or forecasting, with models of physical or real-world systems that ran in production for more than one season. Energy, weather, process industry, plant breeding, pharma, batteries or trading: the field matters less than the fact that it was real
You’ve taken a forecast people didn’t trust and turned it into one a business commits money on
You’ve shipped models that broke when the world changed (a new season, a new site, a new customer) and fixed them, more than once. You can tell us what broke each time
Deep expertise in time series and probabilistic forecasting: Bayesian and hierarchical models, gradient boosting, deep learning for sequences, and uncertainty quantification on small, irregular datasets
Validation that holds up: backtests against strong baselines, error analysis tied to business impact, drift monitoring, and evaluation tools other people kept using after you built them
Production-grade Python (pandas or polars, scikit-learn, PyTorch or JAX, PyMC or similar) and solid engineering habits (Git, testing, CI/CD, Databricks, AWS), so your models run in production without you
An MSc or PhD background and the habit of reasoning from first principles
You work AI-native: coding agents and LLM tools are part of how you work every day, and you know where they fail
You’ve worked alongside people with higher standards than yours, and can tell us what they taught you
Clear communication with growers, product and engineering alike



Nice to have


A degree in engineering, physics, applied mathematics, statistics or econometrics
Experience with physics-informed ML, mechanistic or process-based models, data assimilation (for example, Kalman filtering) or system identification
Publications, talks or open-source work on forecasting or scientific ML



Is this for you?

You’ll probably like it here if you:


Want a hard problem that’s still open, not a plan to execute
Would rather find the real cause than tune a metric
Stand by your view under pressure, and change it when the evidence says so
Want to meet the people who use your work and hear directly from them when it’s wrong



You probably won’t like it here if you:


Need a clear spec, an A/B test or a large, clean dataset to know you’re right
Judge your work by an offline benchmark score
Want to lead a team rather than solve the problem yourself
Want to work only on the model, and leave the data, measurements, growers and production to someone else



What We Offer


Hybrid work: we work together at the Amsterdam office on Mondays and Thursdays
Meals: lunch provided on office days
Pension: a 4.5% pension contribution
Well-being: mental health support through OpenUp
Equipment: a 16" MacBook Pro
Commuting: a travel allowance for your commute to the office
Learning: an annual learning budget of €1,000
Home setup: a €550 budget for your home office
Connectivity: €50 a month for WiFi and phone
Time off: a flexible holiday policy, and we encourage you to take at least 25 days a year
Community: quarterly company events, including dinners and team activities



How we hire


Intro call with the hiring manager or our People Team
One story: tell us about a time a hard project changed direction because of something you did. We’ll ask follow-up questions to understand your part in it
Workshop on a real problem: we send you a short write-up on how a greenhouse works, how plants are measured and where our forecast struggles. Then we work through it together, using your own tools, including AI. We’re not looking for you to agree with us. We want to see what you’d do next
Final conversation and references



At Source, we value diversity of background and perspective. People assess their own qualifications differently, so please apply even if you do not tick every box. We are looking for the right person, not a perfect CV.


Note on AI: we use an AI note-taker during interviews, so we can give you our full attention instead of typing. We don’t record video. If you’d rather we didn’t use it, just let us know at the start of the interview.
Note for candidates outside the Netherlands: we’re only considering candidates who already live in the Netherlands, as we don’t offer relocation support. Interviews take place in person at our Amsterdam office.
Note to recruitment agencies: we don’t accept unsolicited outreach about our open roles. Please don’t contact us about this vacancy.

  • Publications, talks or open-source work on forecasting or scientific ML


Is this for you?

You’ll probably like it here if you:

  • Want a hard problem that’s still open, not a plan to execute
  • Would rather find the real cause than tune a metric
  • Stand by your view under pressure, and change it when the evidence says so
  • Want to meet the people who use your work and hear directly from them when it’s wrong


You probably won’t like it here if you:

  • Need a clear spec, an A/B test or a large, clean dataset to know you’re right
  • Judge your work by an offline benchmark score
  • Want to lead a team rather than solve the problem yourself
  • Want to work only on the model, and leave the data, measurements, growers and production to someone else


What We Offer

  • Hybrid work: we work together at the Amsterdam office on Mondays and Thursdays
  • Meals: lunch provided on office days
  • Pension: a 4.5% pension contribution
  • Well-being: mental health support through OpenUp
  • Equipment: a 16" MacBook Pro
  • Commuting: a travel allowance for your commute to the office
  • Learning: an annual learning budget of €1,000
  • Home setup: a €550 budget for your home office
  • Connectivity: €50 a month for WiFi and phone
  • Time off: a flexible holiday policy, and we encourage you to take at least 25 days a year
  • Community: quarterly company events, including dinners and team activities


How we hire

  • Intro call with the hiring manager or our People Team
  • One story: tell us about a time a hard project changed direction because of something you did. We’ll ask follow-up questions to understand your part in it
  • Workshop on a real problem: we send you a short write-up on how a greenhouse works, how plants are measured and where our forecast struggles. Then we work through it together, using your own tools, including AI. We’re not looking for you to agree with us. We want to see what you’d do next
  • Final conversation and references


At Source, we value diversity of background and perspective. People assess their own qualifications differently, so please apply even if you do not tick every box. We are looking for the right person, not a perfect CV.

  • Note on AI: we use an AI note-taker during interviews, so we can give you our full attention instead of typing. We don’t record video. If you’d rather we didn’t use it, just let us know at the start of the interview.
  • Note for candidates outside the Netherlands: we’re only considering candidates who already live in the Netherlands, as we don’t offer relocation support. Interviews take place in person at our Amsterdam office.
  • Note to recruitment agencies: we don’t accept unsolicited outreach about our open roles. Please don’t contact us about this vacancy.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team in developing high-quality, validated markers that extract insights from dense temporal stacks of satellite imagery across agriculture, land management, and climate. The markers you build form the core of our Area Monitoring System (AMS) delivered to Common Agricultural Policy paying agencies across Europe, owned end-to-end from method to production code. You will collaborate closely with scientists and engineers to deploy models at scale, while expanding beyond compliance into land-cover change detection using embeddings and AI-first workflows.

Ideal candidates are adaptable, curious about AI agents, and eager to iterate directly based on customer feedback. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to work with multi-sensor Earth observation data to solve complex environmental and agricultural challenges.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Graz, Ljubljana or Haarlem office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own


Develop algorithms and machine learning models that extract insights from satellite imagery time series, and maintain and improve the markers we already run.
Take a research topic from exploration through to production.
Own marker results for production AMS deliveries across several EU countries — run them, review them, and confirm quality before they reach the client.
Explore and build embeddings-based insight extraction in new areas beyond CAP.
Use AI agents in your daily work, and help the team get better at it.
Co-own the markers codebase together with the rest of the team.
Collaborate with the team to iteratively build solutions on our platform and existing data building blocks, and inspire and enable our partners to extract insights using them.
Document and organize your work to be transparent and repeatable.
Write internal research reports, public blog posts, and reports for clients.


What You Bring


4+ years of relevant work experience.
Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, data science, or another STEM field.
Understanding of machine learning principles, including model validation and performance evaluation techniques.
Proficiency in Python programming, with the ability to write maintainable, well-documented code.
Experience working with AI agents and modern machine learning tools.
Experience with version control and Git, and comfort working in a shared codebase.
Working knowledge of the geospatial domain.
Ability to deliver projects on schedule and manage technical deliverables.
Problem-solving skills in technical or analytical domains.
Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.


What Makes You Stand Out


Experience working with embeddings or other learned representations of imagery.
Remote sensing expertise, particularly with satellite time series.
Experience processing radar data (for example Sentinel-1).
Familiarity with the agricultural domain, or with the EU Common Agricultural Policy and area-based payment schemes.
Experience with cloud environments and distributed computing.

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

Title: Data Scientist - Supply Chain and E-Commerce
Description:
We think the future is data science. It is the field which combines technology & domain knowledge – leading to amazing outcomes and even more amazing failures. Do you want to keep growing in this domain and are you as passionate as we are about data science (e.g. overexcited sharing of how Bayesian probability works during a birthday party?) – then join us in shaping the future of Agri-Tech.

Kramp Group discovers and builds e-commerce, supply chain, finance & data science solutions that are aiming at giving the ag-tech industry a push forward. We are building a digital platform, serving thousands of customers and generating a turnover of over one billion euros per year. You will join our centralized Data Science team – but will work dedicated for a product/business team.

Your Role


Build data products using Cloud Build and Docker.
Develop pipelines utilizing thousands of CPUs with Kubeflow.
Develop endpoints using GPU’s to improve your domain.
Specialize in one of the following domains with our ecommerce and supply chain operation : Recommenders, Search, Content, Operations and Supply Chain
Translate business problems into data science solutions.
Work at least 3 days per week physically from our office in Utrecht or Varsseveld, with the remaining days (optionally) remote.


Why Join Us?


Innovative Environment: We use cutting-edge technologies & AI tools, while validating everything through experimentation.
Empowerment: We believe in empowering individuals to take control of their own growth, with guidance provided.
Transparent Culture: We offer a transparent environment with a mature management team that has a clear vision and specific goals.
Work-Life Balance: We prioritize work-life balance and offer flexible working arrangements.


Who are you?


A completed Master's degree, preferably in Data Science or a related field.
2-5 years of experience as a Data Scientist in an e-commerce and supply chain operations environment is required.
A proven ability to thrive in complex, fast-paced environments, solving challenging business problems through data and translating insights into measurable business impact.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong skills in SQL and Python (OOP).
Experienced working in CI/CD environments & Git.
Experience with Google Cloud, LightGBM and Kubeflow is beneficial.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.


What do we offer? 

At Kramp, we believe meaningful rewards help people grow, perform, and thrive. Our reward package is designed to be fair, transparent, and competitive, giving you confidence and support to do your best work.

We offer an attractive salary of €5,062 - €6,328 gross per month, depending on your experience and qualifications.

The Compensation Package Also Includes


25 vacation days and 12 ADV days (based on a fulltime contract)
Flexible working policy in hours and location. Please note that this is a hybrid position, requiring a minimum of 2 days per week on-site at either our Utrecht office or Varsseveld headquarters (QH).
Travel and working from home allowance
Profit sharing bonus
Great budget for training and courses
Generous pension plan


Procedure and contact

If this role and its requirements excite you, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply via the application button and submit your CV and motivation letter.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement but believe you’re a strong fit, we encourage you to apply and tell us why.

Do you have a question about this role? Please don’t hesitate to contact opal.srithaporn@kramp.com

Thanks to our ambitions we are active throughout Europe: a leading position in the agricultural market for parts. We heavily invest in E-Business and innovations. Our aim is to make it easy for our customers to run their business. Working at Kramp means working with over 3500 international colleagues. The people at Kramp are enthusiastic, professional and involved. We speak our customers’ language, understand their challenges and earn their trust to exceed their expectations. Our promise “It’s that easy” is embedded in our culture and DNA.

… your work makes a difference! Have an impact on what matters

Title: R&D AI Data Scientist
HTML:
Over Terramira

Terramira is een nieuwe kracht in Earth Intelligence, ontstaan uit de gecombineerde expertise van NEO, eLEAF en 52impact.

Wij zetten satelliet- en sensordata om in bruikbare informatie voor uitdagingen als klimaatverandering, waterschaarste, biodiversiteit en infrastructuur. Onze klanten – van agro-ondernemingen en waterautoriteiten tot internationale organisaties en overheden – hebben behoefte aan inzichten die betere beslissingen mogelijk maken. Dat is precies wat wij leveren.


Bij Terramira geloven we dat impact begint met helder zien. We maken impact zichtbaar. En we brengen deze binnen bereik.

Wij zijn een groeiende organisatie met korte lijnen, een open cultuur en een oprechte drive om werk te doen dat ertoe doet.


Over de functie

Als AI Data Scientist ontwikkel je AI-modellen die geospatiale data omzetten in bruikbare intelligence. Je werkt met satelliet- en luchtbeelden, tijdreeksen en sensordata om veranderingen in water, natuur, landbouw en infrastructuur zichtbaar en meetbaar te maken. Je combineert diepgaande kennis van machine learning met gevoel voor de geospatiale en ruimtelijke context van onze data — en zorgt dat de uitkomsten betrouwbaar zijn, waar en wanneer ze ook worden toegepast.


Wat ga je doen?

Je traint en evalueert machine-learning- en deep-learning-modellen, en past computer vision toe op satelliet- en luchtbeelden om veranderingen in water, natuur, landbouw en infrastructuur zichtbaar te maken. Daarnaast ontwikkel je time-series- en spatiotemporele modellen en werk je met Earth Observation foundation models, die je waar nodig fine-tuned voor onze specifieke toepassingen.


Concreet houdt dat onder andere in dat je:

  • Veranderingen detecteert in water, natuur, landbouw of infrastructuur;
  • Natuurlijke-taalvragen vertaalt naar concrete ruimtelijke en temporele analyses;
  • Modelresultaten valideert over verschillende locaties, seizoenen en databronnen, zodat klanten kunnen vertrouwen op wat we opleveren.


Wat zoeken we?

Je hebt ruime ervaring met machine learning, deep learning en computer vision, en weet je weg met time-series- en spatiotemporele modellering. Je hebt eerder gewerkt met foundation models, model training, fine-tuning en model-evaluatie, en je hebt affiniteit met uncertainty estimation en explainable AI, zodat je resultaten niet alleen accuraat maar ook uitlegbaar zijn.

Daarnaast breng je mee:


  • Kennis van remote sensing, GIS, raster- en vectordata, satellietbeelden, SAR, multispectrale data en/of LiDAR;
  • Begrip van coördinatensystemen en spatial statistics;
  • Goede Python-vaardigheden en ervaring met databases zoals PostgreSQL;
  • Ervaring met reproduceerbare analyses, feature engineering, data preparation, experiment tracking en model pipelines.


Ervaring met Parquet, parallelisatieframeworks zoals Ray, orchestratiekaders zoals Dagster, MLflow of FastAPI is niet vereist, maar wel een mooie pre. Je beheerst de Engelse taal; kennis van het Nederlands is een pre. Je communiceert gemakkelijk met collega's en werkt net zo goed zelfstandig als in teamverband.


Wat bieden wij?

  • Een veelzijdige functie binnen een groeiend en duurzaam bedrijf voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;
  • Flexibele werktijden;
  • Hybride werken, waaronder twee dagen per week op kantoor;
  • Een kantoor nabij het treinstation en op loopafstand van het bruisende centrum van Amersfoort;
  • Een dynamisch team van collega's die gedreven zijn om de wereld een betere en veiligere plek te maken;
  • Een informele werkomgeving met veel ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling;
  • 25 feestdagen, met de mogelijkheid om een extra week te kopen;
  • Een salaris dat overeenkomt met je ervaring en achtergrond.


Ben je klaar om impact te maken?

Wil jij AI-modellen bouwen die daadwerkelijk laten zien wat er met onze planeet gebeurt? Solliciteer dan snel!

Title: Marketing Data Scientist – CHO Herengracht Amsterdam | 40h
Description:
Shape the future of e-commerce and digital marketing by joining our digital team! Bring your digital (marketing) expertise and entrepreneurial spirit to the table, and let's create exceptional omni-channel experiences together.

Share your talents

Are you passionate about untangling complex marketing data to discover what truly drives growth? Do you thrive at the intersection of advanced data science and strategic marketing consulting? Then this could be your next adventure.

At Rituals, we’re looking for a Senior Marketing Data Scientist to take ownership of our marketing measurement initiatives. You will be a driving force behind our measurement triangle, bringing together Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), and Incrementality Testing.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear direction for our marketing teams, helping shape smarter budget decisions and stronger campaign performance. You will not only build and improve models but also act as a trusted advisor who translates technical outcomes into practical recommendations. Working closely with digital, marketing, and data colleagues, you will help us strengthen our measurement capabilities and create a more connected view of impact across channels. It is a role with visible business impact, where curiosity, ownership, and thoughtful challenge are just as important as technical depth.

Share your Talent


You will drive our Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) initiatives. Using Bayesian modeling, you will measure and quantify both the short-term direct revenue and the long-term brand-building impact of our marketing investments.
You will be responsible for the end-to-end development and optimization of our Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) framework. Utilizing GA4 data and advanced algorithmic models, you will map out complex customer journeys to help teams steer on granular, day-to-day media tactics.
You will design and execute our Test & Learn roadmap with different digital marketing teams. By running controlled experiments you will measure true causal impact. You will prove which sales were actually driven by our campaigns, validating our models and ensuring we optimize our budgets with confidence.
You will build a Unified Measurement View. You will bridge the gap between MMM, MTA, and testing - calibrating the models against each other to create a single source of truth and clear guidance for the business.
You will translate models into media action. By actively running media scenario planners and delivering insights, you will help the marketing teams to build highly optimized and profitable media plans.
You will drive measurement adoption. You will operationalize data science outputs by structuring our measurement calendar, defining core reporting templates, and advising marketing teams on KPIs to make data-driven decision-making the standard.


Your team

You will be part of our broader Digital team, sitting within the Digital & Customer Data Insights department. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager Data Science & Marketing Measurement, you will work closely with marketing managers, digital specialists and data colleagues.

Why you’ll love this role


You’ll shape a core marketing measurement capability in a company that’s scaling globally with purpose.
You’ll get the best of both worlds: deep, technical data science work combined with high-level strategic consulting and stakeholder management.
You’ll have a visible business impact, where your models and insights directly fuel smarter media investments.
You’ll work alongside smart, passionate colleagues across digital, marketing, and the wider data science team.


Bring all of you

Your Qualifications


A degree in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Engineering.
3+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative role, specifically within a marketing, media or commercial context.
A strong technical foundation in programming (e.g. Python and SQL) and familiarity with cloud environments and data visualization tools.
Experience with, or a strong understanding of, marketing measurement techniques (such as MMM, Attribution or Incrementality Testing) and digital marketing data (e.g. GA4).
The ability to translate complex data science concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for media managers and senior leadership.
Proven experience independently driving complex analytics or data science projects from problem definition through stakeholder adoption.


On Top Of This


You combine strong technical expertise with a grounded and thoughtful consulting mindset.
You understand that the value of data science is not only in building models, but in helping people make better decisions with confidence.
You feel comfortable working in a complex measurement landscape and know how to bring structure and clarity when not every answer is certain.
You are curious, proactive, and motivated by meaningful impact.


At Rituals, we are committed to care for everyone and strive to create a diverse workplace where all employees belong and have equal opportunities to succeed. Read more about our commitment here: Diversity and Inclusion. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and teamwork. Therefore, we work predominantly from the office.

Grow with us! The next steps are:


Apply via our website (make sure you meet the requirements and tell us why you apply).
Our recruiter will contact you within 10 working days.
A first interview follows in our Central Head Office in Amsterdam.
You do an online assessment.
You have the second interview.
In the event of a positive outcome, you will receive a proposal with the terms of employment.


Please note that applications via e-mail and LinkedIn are not taken into consideration. We kindly ask recruitment agencies to refrain from acquisition efforts.

Benefits of working at Rituals


Unique opportunities for personal and professional growth
Staff discount on Rituals products
Attractive bonus
Flexible working hours tailored to your personal rhythm
Company & team events

About Waving and us

Waving is a rapidly growing and strongly funded deep tech startup that redefines the

security industry by protecting lives and buildings with an invisible security layer. Using our in-house created AI and Wi-Fi waves we detect human movement in ways not possible until now and use it to protect the world's critical infrastructure. With unusually strong commercial traction across some of the world's biggest airports, ports and government organisations we have innovation partners to develop our technology to scale and we're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead Waving's data pipeline. You'll be joining an amazing, talented and fun team that's moving and growing fast and where you'll be making a real impact, shaping the security of tomorrow.




About the role we're looking for

We're looking for a full-time Senior Data Scientist in Amsterdam to own Waving’s data handling end-to-end, building robust services that perform in protecting critical infrastructure in real-world settings. Working hands-on with real-world sensing data, build and validate detection models, and help translate experiments into reliable performance in operational environments such as security control rooms - prioritising what matters and driving execution in data science. This is a highly pivotal role, side-by-side with our CTO, Head of Product and the Tech Team to support Waving's near-future scalable product: solving real security problems and delivering real customer value.




What we can offer you

Being part of an amazing, talented and fun team that's here to make a real impact together
Being part of a fast-growing and well-funded start-up, using incredibly cool tech to protect the world's critical infrastructure in times when it's needed more than ever
The opportunity to own and shape end-to-end data handling and shape the company's products
A fun and fast work culture that's based on trust, freedom and ownership
A generous salary package
Equity compensation, stock options on Waving's shares




Who we're looking for

5+ years work experience outside of academia
Proven experience with processing real-time data, incl. driving data science, analyzing and cleaning large-scale sensing datasets, creating repeatable pipelines
3+ years professional experience with Python
Proven experience with taking a new product to market, including deployed of the product's systems and maintainance / servicing after deployment
At least a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or Physics
Highly valued: experience in working with RF signals, signal processing (time-series, filtering, FFT, feature extraction) and wireless communication
Experience in designing experiments and evaluation methodologies, defining metrics, and reporting results with documentation
Develop, test, and improve models for detection and classification, working closely with engineering to deploy models and iterate based on field performance
Build lightweight tooling to visualize data, debug edge cases, and accelerate iteration
Nice to haves: experience working in a cloud environment. Experience in the security industry is a valuable asset

Ben jij een data scientist die energie haalt uit het verbeteren, versnellen en vereenvoudigen van processen voor klanten én collega’s? Heb je een passie voor innovatie en wil je jouw kennis inzetten op een plek waar technologie en mensgerichtheid samenkomen? Dan is dit jouw kans.

Wat je gaat doen

Binnen het AI-kernteam van NN Pensioen werk je aan uiteenlopende en betekenisvolle AI-oplossingen, van voorspelmodellen tot het slim automatiseren van processen. Als data scientist vertaal je businessvraagstukken naar krachtige data-oplossingen en draag je bij aan het succesvol in productie brengen hiervan.

Je ziet kansen, denkt mee over nieuwe toepassingen en versnelt de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen.

Ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI-oplossingen, waaronder Generative AI, LLMs, Cognitive Services en OpenAI
Samenwerken met collega’s uit de business om hun behoeften te vertalen naar AI-oplossingen
Signaleren van kansen om bedrijfsprocessen te optimaliseren met behulp van AI en waarde toe te voegen voor de klant
Continu verbeteren van modellen die in productie zijn, zodat ze blijvend waarde leveren

NN investeert in een inclusieve, inspirerende werkomgeving en in vaardigheden en competenties voor de toekomst. Salaris tussen € 5.030 en € 6.707 obv 40u, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
13de maand en vakantiegeld, maandelijks uitbetaald bij je salaris
27 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 5 dagen en 3 diversiteitsdagen

Volop training- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
NS Business Card 2e klas, waarmee je onbeperkt kunt reizen, ook privé. Reis je liever met eigen vervoer? Declareer dan je kilometers
Thuiswerkvergoedingen voor internet en een goede werkplek


Wat je meebrengt


Je beschikt over minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als Data Scientist en je hebt een afgeronde wo-opleiding met een master in Computer Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde of een andere STEM-gerelateerde studie
Aantoonbare ervaring met Python en het ontwikkelen van ML-toepassingen, het uitrollen van LLMs of het implementeren van RAG
Ervaring met LangGraph en agentic frameworks is een pré
Praktische kennis van het data science-proces, zoals dataverzameling, opschoning, modelbeoordeling en modelimplementatie

Analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, met een proactieve en klantgerichte houding, uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken binnen een Agile team en met eindgebruikers

Je werkt dagelijks met een hecht team van data scientists, data business process managers en een product owner die zorgt voor structuur en focus. Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About The Opportunity

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.

The Problems You'll Get to Solve


Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.
Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise
Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.
Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.
Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.


What You'll Be Doing


Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.
Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.
Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.
Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.
Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.


What We Look For


Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.
Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.
A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.
Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.
Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.
Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.


Nice To Have


Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.


At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Wat als jij met data en slimme modellen niet alleen inzichten creëert, maar ook de toekomst van de bouw helpt vormgeven? Als Data Scientist bij BAM zet je jouw passie voor data en innovatie om in impactvolle oplossingen. Samen met collega’s werk je aan uitdagende vraagstukken en maak je met jouw expertise en vernieuwende ideeën écht het verschil.

Maak het mogelijk

Als Data Scientist bij BAM duik je in de data van onze bouwwereld. De data varieert van klantdata tot data van de bouwplaats en van duurzaamheid tot aan financiële data. Je speelt een essentiële rol in het leveren van datagestuurde inzichten die de kern vormen van strategische beslissingen.

Jouw werk bestaat uit:


  • Het ontwikkelen van geavanceerde algoritmes. Je ontwerpt, test en implementeert geavanceerde algoritmes voor het verbeteren van bedrijfsprocessen of data inzichten;
  • Op basis van statistische methodologieën voer je complexe (voorspellende) analyses uit en ontdek je patronen in de data ten behoeve van strategische besluitvorming;
  • Je kan goed samenwerken met de business ten behoeve van de integratie van nieuwe algoritmes en modellen;
  • Je werkt met cutting edge technologieën met ruimte voor experimenten en ontwikkelingen.


Jouw team

Je komt te werken in ons Data Competence Centre bestaande uit een team van 40 collega’s. Samen werken Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Architecten en Data Analisten aan het ondersteunen van de business met relevante inzichten en dashboards. We werken Agile en volgen de verschillende scrum ceremonies.

Wij bieden jou

Bij BAM geloven we in het investeren in onze medewerkers en het creëren van een positieve en inclusieve werkcultuur. Bij BAM kun je hybride werken, waardoor je flexibel kunt werken en een goede balans kunt vinden tussen werk en privé.

Daarnaast bieden we je:


  • Een salaris tussen de € 4.500,- en € 6.300,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring. Dit is op basis van een 40-urige werkweek en exclusief 8% vakantiegeld;
  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de Bouw en Infra cao, inclusief 25 vakantiedagen, 15 roostervrije dagen en 3 kortverzuimdagen per kalenderjaar;
  • Een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid bovenop je brutosalaris (conform CAO Bouw & Infra, 2,30%);
  • Vergoeding van je reiskosten (100% OV of een kilometervergoeding), laptop en iPhone;
  • Een unieke kans om jezelf in de breedte te ontwikkelen, waarbij je via onze eigen ‘BAM Learning’ op de hoogte blijft van de nieuwste technieken en kennis. Daarnaast zijn andere cursussen en trainingen altijd bespreekbaar;
  • Fijne extra’s zoals gemiddeld 40 procent korting op jouw sport(school)abonnement en korting op o.a. privéverzekeringen en Microsoft Office.


Hier herken jij jezelf in

We zoeken een proactieve en ambitieuze Data Scientist met minstens 2-3 jaar ervaring en een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in een relevante richting zoals Econometrie of Data Science. Je bent innovatief, gedreven en gepassioneerd over het creëren en toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.

Verder vragen wij:


  • Ervaring met SQL, Python en/of R;
  • Ervaring met data visualisatie tools zoals Power BI (DAX is een pre);
  • Bekend met Scrum/Agile principes;
  • Bekend met grote datasets, geavanceerde algoritmes en cloud platformen zoals Microsoft Azure. Kennis van Databricks en Synapse is een pre;
  • Uitstekende analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen;
  • Sterke communicatievaardigheden voor het presenteren van trends en toekomstige ontwikkelingen aan het senior management;
  • Teamspeler met een voorkeur voor samenwerking in een dynamische omgeving;
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.


Over BAM

Bij BAM geloven we dat iedereen de ruimte moet krijgen om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. We werken aan een omgeving waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt. Daarom verwelkomen we mensen met diverse achtergronden, ervaringen en perspectieven. Denk aan verschillen in cultuur, religie, genderidentiteit, fysieke en mentale beperking en meer.

Het sollicitatieproces

Is jouw interesse gewekt? Laat dan via de button ‘solliciteren’ jouw gegevens achter. Onze recruiter Stef Kerstens maakt graag kennis met jou. Heb je nog vragen? Bel, mail of app Stef Kerstens gerust via stef.kerstens@bam.com of 0615850069.

Het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Stap in en maak het mogelijk!

Title: Data Scientist Decision Troopers / AI Advisory
Description:
Lely, founded in 1948, is committed to creating a sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future in agriculture. Driven by the challenges farmers face and the needs of cows, we develop high-quality robots and data systems that improve animal welfare, flexibility, and productivity on dairy farms. Our mission is to support sustainable food production.

For more than 30 years, we have been a global leader in the sales and service of automated systems for successive generations of dairy farmers. Every day, we inspire our colleagues to provide customers with innovative solutions and to be a reliable partner for long-term advice and support. With our state-of-the-art Lely Campus in Maassluis and a worldwide network of dedicated Lely Centers offering tailored sales and service, Lely operates in more than fifty countries.

Job Description

At Lely, we are looking for a Data Scientist who is excited about turning complex data into practical value for dairy farmers. As part of our Digital Farming team in Maassluis, you will use data science and AI techniques to transform data from our robots into actionable insights and advice that help farmers manage their farms more effectively.

Working with data from thousands of connected farms worldwide, you will identify patterns, trends, and opportunities that improve animal health, farm efficiency, productivity, and sustainability. You will develop predictive models and analytical solutions that convert robot and farm data into meaningful recommendations, helping farmers make better decisions and proactively address potential issues before they impact their operations.

Together with other data scientists and domain experts, you will translate business challenges into data-driven solutions. By turning data into tangible advice, you will directly contribute to making farmers' daily work easier and helping them get more value from their Lely solutions every day.

Do you see opportunities in data where others only see numbers? Then we would love to hear from you.

Qualifications


A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
At least 3 years of experience in predictive modeling and translating data into tangible business outcomes.
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI including LLMs and AI agents.
A critical mindset and intellectual curiosity; you enjoy asking questions such as "why?" and "what if?".
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and simple way.
A proactive attitude; you take initiative rather than wait for direction.
A prototyping mindset: rapidly testing ideas, learning fast, and focusing on what delivers value.


Additional Information

Working at Lely means contributing to sustainable progress within one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You help make the agricultural sector more futureproof, and we ensure you have the space, resources, and support to do so.


An international work environment that values collaboration, initiative, and diverse perspectives.
A culture that encourages learning, experimentation, and ownership of ideas.
Excellent employment conditions, including up to 8 weeks of vacation per year and a strong pension scheme.
A salary range of € 5.000 – € 6.000 gross per month, with clear opportunities for growth within the scale.
Full ownership of your own development, with access to a wide range of courses through the Lely Academy.
Daily access to outstanding sports facilities at the Lely Campus: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, basketball and volleyball courts, table tennis, and table football. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training and challenge your colleagues during an active break.
Fresh coffee and tea from our own barista (with milk from our own farm) and a healthy, affordable company restaurant.


Work-life balance


A healthy work-life balance thanks to our hybrid working policy: you work at least three days a week on Campus, with flexible hours and plenty of opportunity to spend additional time onsite (between 06:00 and 20:00).
A free shuttle bus that takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly.
And of course: we love to celebrate! Whether it’s an anniversary or the annual Christmas party. At Lely, we know how to do it. For an impression of our events, take a look at this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WA3e0WHbxE


We are also proud that our vision and efforts have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneurs Award 2025.

Recruitment & selection agency, consultancy, and/or staffing agency?

We appreciate the interest, but we recruit all our candidates directly. We understand that as intermediaries, you want to present candidates for our great positions and contribute to our ambitions, but this is not how we have set up our recruitment process. This means that all unsolicited profiles offered on Lely vacancies will be treated as direct applications.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Take up a key role in our Data Science team where your work has direct and meaningful impact. Be at the core of our data-driven business, building predictive and innovative models shaping our marketing and customer strategy, and driving our growth. And every day at work, you'll be doing your part for all the charities we support.

At Postcode Lottery Group, your data science work directly supports hundreds of charities across environmental, health, and community causes. Every model you build helps raise funds for a fairer, greener world. You'll join a collaborative, impact-driven team that values technical excellence and practical results. We design and deploy advanced machine learning models that make a real difference for our business and charity partners. This is an end-to-end role: from stakeholder conversations to production deployment, you’ll shape solutions that matter. You’ll also help guide the business, explore new opportunities, and demonstrate the power of data.

Ali Palali, Senior Data Scientist: "At the Postcode Lottery Group, we use data science for good. As the Data Scientist team, we build and deploy robust ML models that have a real-world impact, driving business decisions that help us fund a greener, better, and a fairer world. This is a role where you will have plenty of room for innovation, growth, and a clear purpose."

What You’ll Do


You'll apply your skills in predictive modeling and advanced statistical techniques (like regression and classification techniques, forecasting, A/B testing and causal inference), to deeply understand and predict customer behavior, helping us make smarter decisions about retention and value.
We mean it. You will take ownership of your models from end-to-end: from data exploration in Snowflake and feature engineering to deploying your models on AWS SageMaker.
Be responsible for making sure your work is automated, tested, and reliable. You will work closely with GitLab.
You’ll be the one translating fuzzy business questions into concrete data science problems and, just as importantly, translating your complex results back into clear, actionable insights for your stakeholders.
You’ll work closely with our Machine Learning Engineering and Platform team to continuously improve our shared tools, ML platform and best practices.


You’d Describe Yourself As Follows


At least 4-6 years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a proven track record of taking models from an idea to a live, production system.
You have a strong, practical foundation in statistical and machine learning techniques, especially for predictive modeling, regression and classification techniques, and understanding causal impact and A/B testing.
You’re fluent in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels etc.) and write strong, clean SQL (we use Snowflake).
You believe in MLOps and building things that last. You're comfortable with concepts like containerizing models with Docker and CI/CD, and have hands-on experience with GitLab/AWS SageMaker.
You're more than just a modeler—you're a great communicator and a true team player who enjoy collaborating and can guide stakeholders, manage expectations, and make the complex simple.
A monthly salary indication between €4.700,- and €6.100,- based on a 40-hour week and flexible working hours.


Join us! We believe an inclusive organisation is the ideal breeding ground for creativity, collaboration and innovation. Employee solidarity is important to us, too. Each of us has a part to play in that – we are the organisation, after all. We strive to make everyone feel at home. That means keeping an open mind and paying attention to each other’s welfare.

Can you see yourself as part of the team? We encourage you to apply – whatever your roots, religion, age, ability to work or life philosophy.

Please send your CV and cover letter (mandatory) to our Recruitment Business Partner Paulo Pablo through the link above.

Acquisition is not appreciated.

Connect with us on our socials


Linkedin
Instagram
Facebook


We offer

A solid foundation

You can count on a good salary, a variable year-end bonus, and an excellent pension plan.

Development

No matter your role, your growth is a priority. Our Lottery Academy offers plenty of training. You get the chance to move up and work on international projects.

Work and travel

You work in our sustainable building near Amsterdam Zuid station. Plus, if you have a contract for more than 24 hours, you get an NS Business Card. That means free travel all over the Netherlands, even outside work hours!

Fun

We celebrate successes together with monthly drinks and parties. You’ll learn more about our charity partners during inspiring talks and activities. And there’s plenty more to enjoy working here at the Lotteries.

Sports and relaxation

Join pilates, kickboxing, or bootcamp. Or book a chair massage, physiotherapist- or vitality coach session, right at the office. After work, your VIP-KAART gives you free entry to 180 museums and discounts on fun outings.

Work-life balance

For a good balance, you get 28 vacation days per year based on a 40-hour workweek, plus flexible hours. Becoming a mum or dad? Congrats! During your maternity or parental leave, you keep 100% of your salary.

Meet the team

The Postcode Lottery Group is building an International Analytics hub to provide our lotteries with the right models, tools, tech, and best-practices to help realize our growth ambition. In this hub you will be working together with business representatives to identify value adding business cases for advanced statistical analytics. You will be working on exciting and challenging BI, data & AI projects that create real impact for the lotteries and our beneficiary organizations.

About The Postcode Loterij & VriendenLoterij

A marketing-driven charity organisation

The Postcode Lottery Group is a marketing-driven international non-profit organisation. We operate lotteries to raise funds for a fairer, greener and healthier world. Our players win with their neighbours and generate money for charities together – it’s a win-win!

Our purpose: a better world, for everyone

Since our start in 1989, we have raised over €14.5 billion for thousands of charities. Together with our players and 1,500 fellow team members in the Netherlands, Sweden, Great Britain, Germany and Norway, you'll be helping to create a better world every day.

Inclusion and equal opportunities

People are at the heart of what we do. Whether it’s our team, our players, or the thousands of good causes supported, our aim is to play our part in creating a fairer, more equal world. We are open to ideas and are committed to creating a culture that is inclusive, representative and celebrates diversity in everyone. But we are not perfect. We will always strive to do better – that’s just who we are.

This is an end-to-end role: from stakeholder conversations to production deployment, you’ll shape solutions that matter. You’ll also help guide the business, explore new opportunities, and demonstrate the power of data.

Ali Palali, Senior Data Scientist: "At the Postcode Lottery Group, we use data science for good. As the Data Scientist team, we build and deploy robust ML models that have a real-world impact, driving business decisions that help us fund a greener, better, and a fairer world. This is a role where you will have plenty of room for innovation, growth, and a clear purpose."

What You’ll Do

  • You'll apply your skills in predictive modeling and advanced statistical techniques (like regression and classification techniques, forecasting, A/B testing and causal inference), to deeply understand and predict customer behavior, helping us make smarter decisions about retention and value.
  • We mean it. You will take ownership of your models from end-to-end: from data exploration in Snowflake and feature engineering to deploying your models on AWS SageMaker.
  • Be responsible for making sure your work is automated, tested, and reliable. You will work closely with GitLab.
  • You’ll be the one translating fuzzy business questions into concrete data science problems and, just as importantly, translating your complex results back into clear, actionable insights for your stakeholders.
  • You’ll work closely with our Machine Learning Engineering and Platform team to continuously improve our shared tools, ML platform and best practices.

You’d Describe Yourself As Follows

  • At least 4-6 years of experience as a Data Scientist, with a proven track record of taking models from an idea to a live, production system.
  • You have a strong, practical foundation in statistical and machine learning techniques, especially for predictive modeling, regression and classification techniques, and understanding causal impact and A/B testing.
  • You’re fluent in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels etc.) and write strong, clean SQL (we use Snowflake).
  • You believe in MLOps and building things that last. You're comfortable with concepts like containerizing models with Docker and CI/CD, and have hands-on experience with GitLab/AWS SageMaker.
  • You're more than just a modeler—you're a great communicator and a true team player who enjoy collaborating and can guide stakeholders, manage expectations, and make the complex simple.
  • A monthly salary indication between €4.700,- and €6.100,- based on a 40-hour week and flexible working hours.

Join us! We believe an inclusive organisation is the ideal breeding ground for creativity, collaboration and innovation. Employee solidarity is important to us, too. Each of us has a part to play in that – we are the organisation, after all. We strive to make everyone feel at home. That means keeping an open mind and paying attention to each other’s welfare.

Can you see yourself as part of the team? We encourage you to apply – whatever your roots, religion, age, ability to work or life philosophy.

Please send your CV and cover letter (mandatory) to our Recruitment Business Partner Paulo Pablo through the link above.

Acquisition is not appreciated.

Connect with us on our socials

  • Linkedin
  • Instagram
  • Facebook

We offer

A solid foundation

You can count on a good salary, a variable year-end bonus, and an excellent pension plan.

Development

No matter your role, your growth is a priority. Our Lottery Academy offers plenty of training. You get the chance to move up and work on international projects.

Work and travel

You work in our sustainable building near Amsterdam Zuid station. Plus, if you have a contract for more than 24 hours, you get an NS Business Card. That means free travel all over the Netherlands, even outside work hours!

Fun

We celebrate successes together with monthly drinks and parties. You’ll learn more about our charity partners during inspiring talks and activities. And there’s plenty more to enjoy working here at the Lotteries.

Sports and relaxation

Join pilates, kickboxing, or bootcamp. Or book a chair massage, physiotherapist- or vitality coach session, right at the office. After work, your VIP-KAART gives you free entry to 180 museums and discounts on fun outings.

Work-life balance

For a good balance, you get 28 vacation days per year based on a 40-hour workweek, plus flexible hours. Becoming a mum or dad? Congrats! During your maternity or parental leave, you keep 100% of your salary.

Meet the team

The Postcode Lottery Group is building an International Analytics hub to provide our lotteries with the right models, tools, tech, and best-practices to help realize our growth ambition. In this hub you will be working together with business representatives to identify value adding business cases for advanced statistical analytics. You will be working on exciting and challenging BI, data & AI projects that create real impact for the lotteries and our beneficiary organizations.

About The Postcode Loterij & VriendenLoterij

A marketing-driven charity organisation

The Postcode Lottery Group is a marketing-driven international non-profit organisation. We operate lotteries to raise funds for a fairer, greener and healthier world. Our players win with their neighbours and generate money for charities together – it’s a win-win!

Our purpose: a better world, for everyone

Since our start in 1989, we have raised over €14.5 billion for thousands of charities. Together with our players and 1,500 fellow team members in the Netherlands, Sweden, Great Britain, Germany and Norway, you'll be helping to create a better world every day.

Inclusion and equal opportunities

People are at the heart of what we do. Whether it’s our team, our players, or the thousands of good causes supported, our aim is to play our part in creating a fairer, more equal world. We are open to ideas and are committed to creating a culture that is inclusive, representative and celebrates diversity in everyone. But we are not perfect. We will always strive to do better – that’s just who we are.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
HTML:
Vanaf het begin werk je aan uitdagende projecten die je analytische en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden op de proef stellen. Deze projecten kunnen zich in alle onderdelen van Jumbo bevinden, van logistiek tot marketing en van formule tot inkoop. Je bouwt data science producten van begin (ruwe data) tot eind (productieklare modellen). Gemakkelijk 50% van je tijd besteed je aan data-preparatie, exploratie, (geavanceerde) analyses en zelfs wat BI, dus het is belangrijk dat je dat ook leuk vindt naast Machine Learning / het bouwen van AI Agents. We focussen op resultaat, niet op output: klanten veranderen in fans door betere beslissingen op basis van de inzichten die jij ontdekt.

Dit ga je doen

  • Analyseer grote datasets om inzichten te ontdekken die beslissingen in winkels, online en supply chain verbeteren.
  • Bouw voorspelmodellen die helpen winkelvoorraad, de vraag naar producten en klantgedrag beter te voorspellen.
  • Onderzoek commerciële kansen door prijs-, promotie- en assortimentsdata te analyseren.
  • Ontwikkel data-agents, dashboards en geautomatiseerde rapportages waarmee je collega’s dagelijks je data science producten gebruiken.
  • Verbeter de datakwaliteit door datastromen te controleren en issues te signaleren en op te lossen.
  • Test, optimaliseer en implementeer machine learning modellen in onze productieomgeving.
  • Vertaal complexe analyses naar begrijpelijke adviezen voor collega’s buiten Data Science.
  • Lever met modellen directe businessimpact, zoals minder derving, betere beschikbaarheid of hogere klanttevredenheid.


Jouw werkdag als Junior Data Scientist bij Jumbo:

  • 09.00 – 11.00: Je werkt in DataBricks (PySpark) met onze enorme datasets om het model te verbeteren dat de uitwisselbaarheid van producten inschat, wat een sleutelrol speelt in het selecteren van het juiste assortiment.
  • 11.00 – 12.00: Je bekijkt de laatste resultaten van de machine learning modellen in jouw portfolio.
  • 12.00 – 12.45: Lunchmeeting met je collega’s van DS&A in ons Foodcafé.
  • 13.00 – 15.00: Je doet een peer review van een model dat is ontwikkeld door een collega om onze loyaliteitsaanbiedingen te verbeteren, waarbij je die kennis gebruikt om ons assortimentsmodel te verbeteren.
  • 15.00 – 17.00: Je woont een workshop bij die zich richt op het verbeteren van de differentiatie van winkelindelingen met een data-gedreven aanpak.
  • Een MSc of PhD met uitstekende academische resultaten in Computer Science, Econometrie, Data Science of andere kwantitatieve vakgebieden en 0 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring;
  • Passie voor zowel Machine Learning als Agentic AI en een solide begrip van supervised en unsupervised learning methoden (RF, LGBM, XGB, Lasso/Ridge, SVD, KNN, ALS, LLMs, …), statistiek en tijdreeksanalyse (BSTS, SARIMA-X, etc.) en Agentic packages (LangChain/LangGraph, PydanticAI, OpenAI, AutoGen). Kennis van optimalisatiemethoden (LP / MILP) is een sterke pré;
  • Je weet dat het vakgebied Data Science voortdurend evolueert, dus een leergierige houding is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je beseft dat effectief blijven vraagt om het leren van zowel soft- als hard-skills;
  • Je levert liever code en werkende data-producten dan PowerPoint-slides: Python is vereist, PySpark is een sterke pré. Je bouwt graag data-tools in PowerBI. Ervaring met DataBricks is een sterke pré. SQL en R zijn nice-to-haves;
  • Sterke communicatie- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden: je kunt uitleggen wat de ‘so what’ (en soms ‘waarom’) is van een modelaanbeveling. Je neemt eindgebruikers van je modellen mee in het tempo dat past bij de (on)mogelijkheden van je modellen;
  • Hoewel beheersing van de Nederlandse taal een pré is, is het geen vereiste.
  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.900 – €5.100 (op basis van 40 uur);
  • Een jaarlijkse bonus van maximaal 5% van je jaarsalaris, gebaseerd op organisatiedoelen;
  • 30 betaalde vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om dagen te kopen of verkopen) en 8% vakantiegeld. Je bouwt pensioen op via deelname aan het Pensioenfonds voor de Levensmiddelenindustrie;
  • Een reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,21 per kilometer met een maximum van 35 kilometer enkele reis). We werken graag samen op kantoor, maar deels thuiswerken is ook mogelijk;
  • Ruimte voor ondernemerschap, groei en ontwikkeling. Niet alleen in je functie, maar ook via onze Jumbo Academy, online trainingen via GoodHabitz en met een opleidingsbudget;
  • Dagelijks verse lunch in ons Foodcafé, goede koffie en vers fruit. Je kunt dagelijks sporten in onze eigen Jumbo Gym tegen een kleine vergoeding;
  • Collega-kortingen zoals 10% korting op je boodschappen (tot €325 per jaar), deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering of kortingen via Benefits at Work.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Data Scientist – Econometrics / Statistics (Amsterdam)

You could work as a quantitative analyst at an investment bank. Or you could help model one of Europe’s largest real-world consumer markets.




At JP.cars we analyze the dynamics of the European automotive market using one of the most comprehensive vehicle datasets in existence.




Every day millions of vehicle listings across Europe generate a continuously evolving system of supply, demand and pricing signals.

If you enjoy digging deep into data, uncovering patterns others miss and pushing through datasets until things truly make sense, read further.




About JP.cars

JP.cars is a fast-growing automotive data company operating across almost all European markets. In 2027 we will further expand internationally with our entry into the United States.

At the core of our business are very large automotive datasets containing billions of vehicle records across multiple countries.




These datasets provide a unique statistical view on how vehicle markets behave, enabling analysis of pricing dynamics, supply patterns and market inefficiencies at a scale rarely available in this industry.




To unlock the full value of this data, we are looking for someone with a strong statistical and quantitative background who enjoys working deeply with large datasets and complex market behavior.




What you will do

You will build models and work with large-scale automotive data to translate complex datasets into insights and models that support hundreds of customers (automotive dealerships, b2b trading companies, leasing companies, banks, insurance companies and auditors), who rely heavily on our accurate vehicle data to run their daily operations.




Your work may include:

Building statistical models to better understand vehicle pricing and market dynamics
Identifying patterns in supply, demand and pricing behavior
Investigating anomalies and trends in large datasets
Analyzing datasets with billions of vehicle records
Turning complex quantitative analysis into clear insights




A large part of this role is deep data exploration and statistical investigation: asking the right questions and pushing through the data until the numbers actually make sense.

Your analyses and models directly influence vehicle valuations used daily by hundreds of automotive companies across Europe.




Examples of questions we explore

How do vehicle prices evolve across different European markets?
Can statistical models detect anomalies or inefficiencies in vehicle pricing?
How can we forecast vehicle residual values using large-scale market data?
How can price elasticities in the automotive market be quantified?




What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who really enjoys working with numbers and data.

Strong candidates typically have:

A PhD or MSc in Mathematics, Econometrics, Statistics, Physics, or another quantitative field
Strong knowledge of statistics and quantitative modeling
Experience working with large datasets
Programming experience with Python, SQL and more




Most importantly, we are looking for someone who:

Has a strong drive to understand data in detail
Enjoys digging deep into datasets
Keeps investigating when something does not make sense
Does not stop until the numbers and patterns are fully understood




We value people who enjoy exploring data, questioning assumptions, and developing a deep understanding of how underlying systems and markets behave.

At the same time, you enjoy working closely with others and contributing to a team that builds something meaningful together.




What we offer

Access to one of the largest automotive datasets in Europe with billions of records
Real-world problems involving pricing and market dynamics
A role where your analysis directly influences real decisions in the automotive market

To unlock the full value of this data, we are looking for someone with a strong statistical and quantitative background who enjoys working deeply with large datasets and complex market behavior.
