  • Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle nye faglige kapaciteter

Ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Ballerup

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Jesper Berg Madsen på telefon 2974 3451.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Julie Cramer-Palmquist på telefon 3266 5848.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 2. november 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf. Stillingen er til besættelse snarest muligt

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse

Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er Danmarks centrale myndighed for forsvarets og beredskabets materiel, it og cybersikkerhed i fred, krise og krig. Vi arbejder for at sikre, at det samlede forsvar er udstyret, opdateret og operativt — i en tid, hvor kravene til hastighed og kampkraft aldrig har været større. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og it for Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Det er vores it-medarbejdere, der dagligt er med til at afværge de cyberangreb, koncernen udsættes for. Vi er en mangfoldig organisation med ca. 2.500 medarbejdere — civile og militære — fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget.

Title: Senior Analyst - Consumer Credit Risk & Underwriting
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances.Working at Klarna means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else. You'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna is bringing its Fair Financing product live in Denmark. As a Senior Analyst on the credit decisioning team, you'll build and defend the underwriting policies that decide who gets credit in Denmark and on what terms, working from bureau data and models built specifically for the Danish market.

You'll work alongside Product, Risk, and the regional Belgium team to bring that policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform (GUP), the shared framework that will power credit decisions across markets.

What You'll Do


You'll analyze consumer credit risk using SQL and Danish credit bureau data to find where underwriting policy should tighten or loosen.
You'll work with Product, Risk, and the Danish regional team to bring Denmark’s credit policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform.
You'll align purchase power and pre-qualification logic for the Danish market across Klarna's App and its One Card product.
You'll monitor how the Danish bureau data feeding your models performs, and flag where sourcing or model quality needs to change.
You'll turn what your analysis shows into policy changes that underwriting, product, and the regional team can act on directly.


Who you are


You've worked in consumer credit risk, underwriting, or credit policy, and you understand how a policy change affects both approval rates and portfolio health.
You're proficient in SQL and comfortable working directly with large, messy datasets.
You know credit bureau data, repayment behavior, and credit risk modeling well enough to spot where the numbers don't add up.
You work through ambiguous or inconsistent policy logic methodically until you find the actual root cause.
You can turn a data finding into a policy change that underwriting, product, and regional teams can each act on.


Bonus points for


A degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.


Things you should know before applying


Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.
Depending on your background, this could land as an Analyst role or a Data Scientist role — we'll settle the exact title with you once we understand your experience.


Please include a CV in English.

Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it’s like to work here? Explore our career site.

Title: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

Your primary responsibilities:


Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.
Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.
Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.
Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.
Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.



Are you the one we are looking for?

We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:


hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,
have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,
have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,
are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,
understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,
are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,
communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,
have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.



Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your new team

You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

About Nykredit Markets

Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

Want to know more?

You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Title: AI-udvikler søges til Dansk Center for Partikelterapi, AUH
Description:
AI-udvikler søges til Dansk Center for Partikelterapi, AUH,

Dansk Center for Partikelterapi (DCPT) søger en fysiker, hospitalsfysiker, datalog, softwareingeniør eller lignende profil til softwareudvikling inden for adaptiv protonterapi. DCPT er et nationalt center, der giver strålebehandling med protonterapi. Vores mission er at levere protonterapi af højest mulig kvalitet til alle relevante danske kræftpatienter. Alle vores udviklingsopgaver er forankret i brede tværfaglige, lokale, nationale og/eller internationale udviklings- og forskningsgrupper.

I denne nyoprettede stilling er der fokus på at løse de kliniske behov bl.a. gennem forskning, som bliver en vigtig del af din dagligdag. Du vil blive tilknyttet gruppen af fysikere og dosimetrister, hvis driftsopgave er at planlægge individuelle protonbehandlinger og kvalitetssikre behandlinger og tilhørende udstyr. Gruppen udvikler behandlingsteknikker i tæt samarbejde med læger, sygeplejersker, radiografer, m.fl., samt de ansatte i vores forskningsafdeling. DCPT har udviklet kunstig intelligens til at forbedre billedkvaliteten af de billeder vi anvender til at adaptere patientbehandlingen, samt til segmentering af medicinske billeder. Vi ønsker at styrke denne indsats og målrette den mod udviklingen af adaptiv protonterapi, hvor den individuelle tilpasning af behandlingen sker hurtigere og på daglig basis.

Det er afgørende, at du har følgende kompetencer


solid erfaring med maskinlæring og deep learning anvendt på billeddata - gerne 3D medicinsk billedbehandling: segmentering, registrering eller billede-til-billede-modeller
rutine i PyTorch eller tilsvarende, og erfaring med at træne, evaluere og fejlsøge modeller på virkelige datasæt
håndværksmæssig disciplin i kodning: versionsstyring, test, dokumentation og kodegennemgang. Du skal kunne bygge noget, som andre end dig selv kan overtage og videreudvikle
evnen til at arbejde tæt sammen med fysikere og klinikere, og til at sætte dig ind i et domæne du ikke selv er uddannet i.


Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har


kendskab til medicinsk billedbehandling i praksis: DICOM og DICOM-RT, strålebehandlingsplanlægning, scripting mod et planlægningssystem
erfaring med at drifte modeller i produktion: containere, inferensservere, versionering af modeller og data og overvågning
serverdrift og databaser
kendskab til softwareudvikling under EU's forordning om medicinsk udstyr, herunder undtagelsen for egenudviklet software, samt kvalitetssystemer, risikostyring og validering
baggrund som fysiker eller erfaring fra stråleterapi.


Med ansættelse ved DCPT skal du være indstillet på at kunne brede dig ud over flere forskelligartede opgaver, der vil veksle mellem udviklingsopgaver og driftsorienterede opgaver. Din opgave- og projektportefølje vil udvikle sig over tid, og afhængigt af dine kompetencer vil den komme til at indeholde forskning, udvikling og drift.

Uanset hvor vægten kommer til at ligge, skal du


konstruktivt, effektivt og aktivt kunne indgå i samarbejder med forskere og klinikere
kunne sætte dig ind i brugeres og domænets behov
være ambitiøs og have lyst til at fuldføre dit arbejde med både praktiske og akademiske resultater
være indstillet på at løse mangeartede opgaver.


Det forventes, at du i samarbejde med DCPT's øvrige akademiske medarbejdere deltager aktivt i forsknings- og udviklingsopgaver. Du kommer til at indgå i et tværfagligt miljø med fysikere, læger, sygeplejersker, radiografer og andre, der ligeledes arbejder for at udvikle teknologi og klinisk udnyttelse af protonterapi. Er du kandidat, der opfylder indgangskrav til uddannelse som hospitalsfysiker, så vil centeret tilbyde dig uddannelsen. Hvis ikke, vil vi tilbyde lignende skræddersyet uddannelse og træning.

For yderligere information om stillingerne kontakt hospitalsfysiker, lektor Jesper Kallehauge på mail jespkall@rm.dk eller cheffysiker Ole Nørrevang på tlf. 2117 4193. Bemærk at Jesper Kallehauge ikke er tilgængelig for yderligere information før efter den 27. oktober.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Copenhagen, Denmark

About The Job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

As our new Quantitative Risk Analyst, you will:


Develop and enhance quantitative models, methodologies, and risk measures relating to liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk, and capital management.
Build analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide insights into earnings, funding, liquidity, and risk exposures.
Perform quantitative analysis of balance sheet developments, business initiatives, and market events to support risk and treasury decision-making.
Contribute to the automation and improvement of risk analytics using modern analytical tools and programming languages.
Assist in the development and validation of methodologies used for risk measurement, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading, Secured Finance, and Technology to deliver scalable analytical solutions.
Support the preparation of analysis and material for senior management, risk committees, and regulatory interactions.
Support the ongoing development of analytical frameworks such as Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Value of Client Funds (VCF), stress-testing methodologies, and balance sheet optimisation tools.


Your profile

This role is ideally suited to candidates with around 4-5 years of relevant experience who are looking to further develop their quantitative, analytical, and banking expertise while taking on increasing responsibility and ownership. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience if they bring highly relevant expertise and a strong foundation within the areas covered by the role.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems through data, modelling, and quantitative analysis. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by understanding how financial and business decisions impact earnings, risk, and balance sheet performance.

Title: Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Brøndby Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Bliv en del af et stærkt datamiljø, hvor machine learning og AI allerede er en del af hverdagen – og vær med til at udvikle løsninger, der skaber reel værdi for både kunderne og forretningen.




Hos nemlig er fundamentet på plads: en moderne GCP-baseret dataplatform, stærke datateams og en organisation, hvor data, machine learning og AI spiller en central rolle. Nu søger vi en Machine Learning Engineer, der vil være med til at bygge videre.




Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med personalisering af indkøbsoplevelsen, forecasting af vores drift og andre ML-use cases på tværs af forretningen. Fælles for løsningerne er, at de skal hele vejen fra idé og model til produktion – og fungere stabilt og skabe målbar værdi i praksis.




For os er en god ML-løsning ikke nødvendigvis den mest avancerede model. Det er den løsning, der virker, bliver brugt og skaber værdi.




Din rolle – fra idé til produktion

Du arbejder på tværs af hele ML-livscyklussen: fra dataforberedelse og feature engineering til modeludvikling, deployment, monitorering og løbende forbedringer.




Samtidig arbejder du tæt på forretningen. Du tager selv dialogen med de stakeholders, du bygger løsninger til, sætter dig ind i deres udfordringer og er med til at omsætte dem til ML-løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.




Fundamentet er på plads, men der er stadig meget at forme. Derfor får du både ansvar for konkrete løsninger og mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med machine learning og AI fremadrettet.




Hvad du bliver en del af

Du bliver en del af DataMind – vores centrale data- og ML-team – hvor vi arbejder på tværs af Data Engineering, Machine Learning, BI og forretningen.




Vi har en moderne GCP-baseret dataplatform, stabile pipelines og høj datakvalitet og bygger løbende videre på vores ML-platform og MLOps-praksis.




AI er allerede en naturlig del af vores engineering-praksis. Vi bruger AI-værktøjer aktivt i udviklingsarbejdet og arbejder blandt andet med agentic workflows, hvor de kan gøre os hurtigere og bedre. Samtidig udforsker vi løbende nye muligheder for at bringe AI ind i vores kunde- og forretningsløsninger.




Vi er nået langt, men udviklingen går stærkt, og ambitionerne er større. Derfor får du også mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi bruger AI fremadrettet – både i de løsninger, vi bygger, og i måden vi selv arbejder på.




Dine opgaver

Udvikle, vedligeholde og forbedre ML-løsninger til blandt andet personalisering af indkøbsoplevelsen, forecasting af driften og andre kommercielle, operationelle og kundevendte use cases
Arbejde med dataforberedelse, feature engineering, træning, evaluering og løbende forbedring af modeller
Drive ML-use cases tæt sammen med forretningen – fra behov og problemstilling til løsning
Bidrage til robuste pipelines for data, features, modeltræning og inferens
Modne vores MLOps-praksis inden for blandt andet deployment, monitorering og automatisering
Sikre høj kvalitet og driftssikkerhed i de ML-løsninger, du arbejder med




Sådan arbejder vi

Moderne GCP-baseret dataplatform
Python som primært udviklingssprog til machine learning og dataarbejde
CI/CD, monitorering, observability og automatisering som naturlige dele af udviklingsarbejdet
Reproducerbare workflows, datasporbarhed og veldokumenterede modeller
Tæt samarbejde mellem ML, Data Engineering og forretningen
AI-værktøjer og agentic workflows som en integreret del af vores engineering-praksis




Din profil

Vi er mindre optaget af titler og anciennitet end af din evne og lyst til at omsætte machine learning til løsninger, der virker i praksis.




Du kan sandsynligvis nikke genkendende til flere af følgende:

Erfaring med at udvikle, træne og evaluere ML-modeller
Stærke kompetencer inden for Python og databehandling
Erfaring med feature engineering, modellering og anvendelse af ML på konkrete problemstillinger
Interesse for eller erfaring med MLOps, deployment og monitorering
Forståelse for software engineering-principper, testbarhed og skalerbare løsninger
Nysgerrighed på AI og nye teknologier – og lyst til aktivt at udforske, hvordan de kan forbedre både vores løsninger og måden, vi arbejder på
Drive og lyst til at tage ejerskab og arbejde selvstændigt tæt sammen med forretningen




Måske kommer du fra en rolle som Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer eller noget tredje. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bygge, lære og skabe værdi sammen med resten af teamet.




Plads til at bygge

Hos os får du:

Mulighed for at forme næste generation af ML- og AI-løsninger i DataMind
Kort vej fra idé til produktion – vi prioriterer handling over PowerPoints
Reelt ejerskab og indflydelse på de løsninger, du bygger
Et fagligt stærkt team med høje ambitioner og en uformel omgangstone
Tæt kontakt til forretningen og mulighed for at se effekten af dit arbejde
Fleksibilitet, tillid og frihed under ansvar




Vi tror på, at de bedste ML- og AI-løsninger opstår i krydsfeltet mellem teknologi, data og forretning. Derfor prioriterer vi løsninger, der skaber reel værdi – og mennesker, der har lyst til at drive dem frem.

Title: Forretningsdrevet data- og analysekonsulent til Faciliteter i Københavns Kommune
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vi søger dig, som er dygtig til at modellere og arbejde med data. Du har lyst til at bygge datagrundlaget for byens svømmehaller, idrætsanlæg, kulturhuse og kirkegårde. Du bidrager med data til forretningen, som giver indsigt i, hvordan den daglige drift bedste udvikles. Lyder det spændende? Så bliv vores nye kollega i teamet Forretningsudvikling i Faciliteter i Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen.




Hvem er vi?

I Forretningsudvikling understøtter og udvikler vi Faciliteters mange driftsområder – fra svømmehaller og idrætsanlæg til kulturhuse, kirkegårde og byens blå parker. Vi arbejder tæt på og sammen med driften. Vi omsætter strategiske mål og konkrete behov til løsninger, der virker i hverdagen. Vores redskaber er data, ny teknologi, investeringscases og nye arbejdsformer. Vi er et tværfagligt team på ca. otte medarbejdere, som er specialister, projektledere og udviklingsprofiler, hvor vi har frihed under ansvar, gode muligheder for sparring, fleksibel arbejdstid og mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.




Om stillingen

Du skal være med til at bygge og modellere selve datagrundlaget for Faciliteter. Du arbejder i hele kæden: Fra rådata i fagsystemer, sensorer og centrale registre, over datamodellen til den analyse eller det dashboard, en driftsleder træffer beslutninger ud fra. Det handler blandt andet om energi- og forbrugsdata, besøgstal, bygnings- og anlægsdata, tilstandsvurderinger og vedligehold.




Du skal samtidig være forretningsorienteret samt understøtte og udvikle vores drift. Det kan fx være ved at belyse en konkret problemstilling med tal, skabe overblik over et område eller afprøve en ny datakilde sammen med ledere og medarbejdere i driften. Vores opgaver tager afsæt i Faciliteters egne driftsområder, og vi arbejder tæt sammen med kollegerne i hele forvaltningen, der har ansvaret for de fælles platforme.




Nogle opgaver vil være klart defineret, mens andre begynder med et spørgsmål, hvor du selv skal afgrænse problemstillingen, finde de relevante data, inddrage de rette kolleger og drive arbejdet frem mod en løsning.




Dine primære opgaver bliver at

opbygge og modellere datagrundlaget for centerets faciliteter, aktiviteter og forbrug
levere analyser, beslutningsgrundlag til driften og centerets ledelse
udvikle og vedligeholde end-to-end machine learning pipelines
udarbejde investeringscases og følge op på de gevinster, de skal skabe
afprøve og implementere ny teknologi og nye arbejdsgange sammen med driften.




Er det dig?

Vi forventer, at du




har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund, fx inden for data, IT, ingeniørvidenskab, økonomi eller en kvantitativ samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse
har grundlæggende kendskab til Python og SQL og gerne erfaring med machine learning pakker såsom Scikit-Learn
kan oversætte mellem drift, data og teknik og forstår, at en analyse først skaber værdi, når den bliver brugt
arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og driver dine opgaver fremad
har erfaring med datamodellering og kan designe datamodeller ud fra store datasæt
kan formidle data visuelt og målrettet, gerne med erfaring fra Power BI eller tilsvarende
har blik for datakvalitet og dokumentation, så løsningerne kan bruges og vedligeholdes af andre end dig selv
er en god formidler skriftligt og mundtligt og samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af fagligheder og niveauer.




Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til grafdatabaser eller semantisk datamodellering, har arbejdet med en eller flere dataplatforme, som fx Databricks eller Microsoft Fabric, MLflow, Azure Cloud eller har arbejdet med bygnings- og ejendomsdata, forsyningsdata eller sensordata.




Om Faciliteter

Faciliteter står for at vedligeholde de fysiske faciliteter for byens idræts- og kulturliv, herunder boldbaner, biblioteker, idrætsanlæg og kulturhuse i Københavns Kommune. Derudover driver Faciliteter alle svømmehaller, friluftsbade, havnebade og strande i Københavns Kommune. Endelig står Faciliteter for natteværterne og tryghedsvagterne i det københavnske natteliv, havneværterne i Københavns Havn og driften af kommunens fem kirkegårde samt de tre blå parker Svanemøllen Strand, Islands Brygge Havnebad og Amager Strandpark.




Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt og senest den 1. januar 2027. Løn følger gældende overenskomst. Dit arbejdssted bliver Nyropsgade 3, 1602 København V. Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter vi referencer.




Yderligere information

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til teamleder i Forretningsudvikling Morten Jørgensen på 20 35 69 75 (send gerne en sms).




Søg via linket senest søndag den 1. november 2026

Vi holder 1. samtaler torsdag den 5. november, og 2. samtaler onsdag den 11. november 2026. Der vil være en mindre case for de kandidater, der går videre til 2. samtale.




Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen

I Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe gode rammer for kultur- og fritidslivet i byen, og for at give københavnerne samt byens gæster en professionel og nærværende service. Fra biblioteker, kulturhuse og museer til idrætsfaciliteter, borgerservice og byens grønne rum – skaber vi rammer for fællesskaber, hvor københavnerne kan mødes og udfolde sig. Vores fælles mål er at gøre København til et godt sted at leve, mødes og engagere sig.

Vi forventer, at du


  • har en relevant uddannelsesbaggrund, fx inden for data, IT, ingeniørvidenskab, økonomi eller en kvantitativ samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse
  • har grundlæggende kendskab til Python og SQL og gerne erfaring med machine learning pakker såsom Scikit-Learn
  • kan oversætte mellem drift, data og teknik og forstår, at en analyse først skaber værdi, når den bliver brugt
  • arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og driver dine opgaver fremad
  • har erfaring med datamodellering og kan designe datamodeller ud fra store datasæt

  • er en god formidler skriftligt og mundtligt og samarbejder konstruktivt på tværs af fagligheder og niveauer.

Faciliteter står for at vedligeholde de fysiske faciliteter for byens idræts- og kulturliv, herunder boldbaner, biblioteker, idrætsanlæg og kulturhuse i Københavns Kommune. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt og senest den 1. januar 2027. Løn følger gældende overenskomst. Dit arbejdssted bliver Nyropsgade 3, 1602 København V. Som led i ansættelsesprocessen indhenter vi referencer.


Yderligere information

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til teamleder i Forretningsudvikling Morten Jørgensen på 20 35 69 75 (send gerne en sms).


Søg via linket senest søndag den 1. november 2026

Vi holder 1. samtaler torsdag den 5. november, og 2. samtaler onsdag den 11. november 2026. Der vil være en mindre case for de kandidater, der går videre til 2. samtale.


Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen

I Kultur-, Fritids- og Borgerserviceforvaltningen arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe gode rammer for kultur- og fritidslivet i byen, og for at give københavnerne samt byens gæster en professionel og nærværende service. Fra biblioteker, kulturhuse og museer til idrætsfaciliteter, borgerservice og byens grønne rum – skaber vi rammer for fællesskaber, hvor københavnerne kan mødes og udfolde sig. Vores fælles mål er at gøre København til et godt sted at leve, mødes og engagere sig.

Title: AI Developer, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
What if you could help companies transform their businesses using AI, machine learning and data? Joining KPMG as an AI Developer means you’ll be working with a variety of clients, applying the latest AI models and leveraging the power of data to optimize operations, enhance customer experience and predict future trends. Take on exciting challenges from day one and shape the future of AI.

About The Role

As an AI Developer in NewTech, you will have the opportunity to develop solutions with the latest AI tools and work with real-world applications that create measurable business value. You will work with both classical machine learning and modern LLM-based solutions, helping clients transform data into intelligent automation and decision support. You will collaborate closely with consultants, data specialists and client stakeholders, gaining experience across the full lifecycle of AI solution development from experimentation to production-ready deployment.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:


Develop and deploy machine learning and LLM-based applications that automate processes and extract insights from complex data.
Design and implement scalable AI solutions following best practices within MLOps, DevOps and DataOps.
Work with modern AI frameworks, tools and cloud platforms to build production-grade applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.
Contribute to shaping how organizations adopt and scale AI capabilities.


Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. What makes our team different is that we do not only advise clients on transformation – we help design, build, and implement solutions together with them. Our projects combine emerging technologies, automation, AI, and organizational change, meaning you will collaborate closely with colleagues across business, and technical disciplines while helping clients turn ideas into practical solutions. 

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists and developers who collaborate closely across projects. Working alongside both junior and senior colleagues, you will gain exposure to different perspectives and contribute to solving complex client challenges.

What sets NewTech apart is our practical focus on consulting by doing. From early on, you will be involved in shaping solutions, testing technologies, and working directly with clients to support adoption, and value realization. Many join NewTech because they want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges, and enjoy working across strategy, implementation, and organizational transformation.

About You, Our New Team Member

You enjoy working with people and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and cross-functional teams. You thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing, teamwork, and mutual support are valued. At the same time, you appreciate a positive and social workplace where professional excellence and having fun go hand in hand.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:


Has solid technical skills in leveraging machine learning and LLM models, with a solid understanding of algorithms and data structures.
Has experience with frameworks such as Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Hugging Face, LangChain, DataBricks, MLFlow, FastAPI, MCP or similar is key and you are skilled in optimizing models for performance, scalability and interpretability.
Is familiar with cloud platforms, data pipelines and version control using Git, allowing you to integrate models into production seamlessly.
Above all, you’re interested in AI’s transformative potential and are keen to stay at the cutting edge of a field that changes almost daily.
Communicates confidently and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.


KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). How you choose to respond is entirely up to you - your answers will help us get to know you better and provide a basis for further discussion in a potential interview.

The questions are:


Describe a project (academic, personal, or professional) where you applied machine learning or AI to solve a real problem. What was the problem, what approach did you take and what did you learn?
Imagine you need to explain the value of a machine learning/ AI solution to a non-technical client. How would you do it?
Why are you interested in an AI Developer role at this stage of your career and what skills or areas are you most excited to develop?


If you have any questions or would like more information, please contact Mårten Waldmann Lauridsen mwaldmann@kpmg.com .

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We can’t wait to hear from you!

Title: Scientific Data Architect - Austria, Denmark or UK
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
About TetraScience

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world's leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience's growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review "The Tetra Way," authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.


Who You Are

You are a product-minded, outcome-obsessed driver of technical scientific solutions.

You a high velocity self-starter. You refuse to let uncertainty obstruct your path to designing and building solutions.

You roll up your sleeves, try things out, and get things done. You do not hesitate to prototype, demo, and build in order to accelerate delivery of products for your end users.

You thrive in environments where you can collaborate with scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform complex scientific data into actionable outcomes. Your ability to engage with scientists and business leaders alike makes you a key player in maximizing the value of scientific data.

With rich experience applying cutting edge data methodologies to the biopharma R&D domain, you bridge understanding between present-day pain points and generalizable solutions.

You are an insatiable learner, with a track record of deeply learning new tools, methods, and domains.

You fundamentally embody the principles of extreme ownership and have a demonstrated history of building extensible data models and applications for Biopharma end users to maximize value from their data via analysis and integration with AI/ML.

This role will require extreme self-discipline and determination as we forge a category that will fundamentally and forever change the life science industry.


What You Have Done


PhD with +4 years or Masters with +8 years of industry experience in life sciences  with extensive domain knowledge in drug discovery (target ID through lead optimization), preclinical development, CMC (all drug modalities), or product quality testing
Proven track record of defining, designing, prototyping, and implementing productized AI/ML-driven use cases in cloud environments
Collaborated with cross-functional teams, including product managers, software engineers, and scientific stakeholders
Performed extensive exploratory data analysis and workflow optimization to enable scientific outcomes not previously possible
Engaged diverse audiences, from scientists to executive stakeholders using your excellent communication and storytelling abilities
Advised scientists in a consulting capacity to further research, development, and quality testing outcomes


Requirements

What You Will Do



You will be a critical team member in a unique partnership to industrialize Scientific AI. As such, you will engage directly with customers onsite and will need to travel up to 25% of your time, building strong relationships, deeply understanding their scientific data challenges and requirements, and accelerating solutions
Design and implement extensible, reusable data models that efficiently capture and organize scientific data for scientific use cases, ensuring scalability and future adaptability
Translate scientific data workflows into robust solutions leveraging the Tetra Data Platform
Own, scope, prototype, and implement solutions including:
Data model design (tabular & JSON)
Python-based parser development
Lab software (e.g., ELN/LIMS) integration via APIs
Data visualization and app development in Python (using app frameworks like Streamlit and plotting tools like holoviews and Plotly) 
Collaborate with Scientific Business Analysts (SBAs), customer scientists and applied AI engineers to develop and deploy models (ML, AI, mechanistic, statistical, hybrid)
Programmatically interrogating proprietary instrument output files
Dynamically iterate with scientific end users and technical stakeholders to rapidly drive solution development and adoption through regular demos and meetings
Proactively communicate implementation progress and deliver demos to customer stakeholders
Collaborate with the product team to build and prioritize our roadmap by understanding customers' pain points within and outside Tetra Data Platform
Rapidly learn new technologies (e.g., new AWS services or scientific analysis applications) to develop and troubleshoot use cases


Benefits



Competitive Salary and equity in a fast-growing company
Supportive, team-oriented culture of continuous improvement
Generous paid time off (PTO)
Flexible working arrangements - Remote work when not at Customer Sites


We are not currently providing visa sponsorship for this position.

Title: Senior Model Developer
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us in this role where you’ll develop and improve core market models that support short- and mid-term analysis. You’ll combine strong Python development with an interest in energy markets to deliver scalable, reliable models used daily by trading and commercial teams.

Welcome to Forecasting & Market Analysis

You’ll be part of Forecasting & Market Analysis where you together with your colleagues will develop models and forecasts supporting trading and portfolio decisions across power and gas. You’ll work closely with analysts, traders, and platform teams to ensure high-quality data-driven insights. As a team, we collaborate across disciplines, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we model and understand energy markets.

You’ll play an important role in:


developing our new gas supply and demand to enable our gas trading and portfolio management activities
developing and improving gas and power market models for supply-demand and price formation.
integrating key drivers such as weather, fuel prices, outages, and interconnector flows into models.
ensuring model outputs reflect market behaviour across short- and mid-term horizons.
improving model governance, monitoring performance, and keeping assumptions and data up to date.
collaborating with traders, analysts, and developers to deliver actionable insights and recommendations.


To succeed in the role, you:


have a background in quantitative development, engineering, economics, or similar, or equivalent experience.
possess deep knowledge of European gas markets
write scalable, well-tested Python code and apply modern development practices.
are familiar with version control, CI/CD, and collaborative software development.
work confidently with data, including time series analysis, SQL, and data visualisation tools.
are motivated to build expertise in energy markets and translate it into models.
communicate clearly and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.


Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

Title: Product Data Insights Lead
Description:
Product Data Insights Lead




Ballerup, DK, 2750




At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.




We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Do you want to turn complex insights into software that makes a real difference to millions of citizens?

Do you have a background in data research and a sharp analytical mind? Can you turn customer research, usage data and competitive signals into evidence that helps product managers act on the right thing at the right time, whether that's a new product or an improvement to an existing one? Then this could be your next role at KMD.




About the role




As Product Data Insights Lead, you carve out the data that matters from the noise around it e.g. customer research, usage patterns, customer feedback, value-hypothesis tests, and competitive and market signals and turn it into clear reports and tools that Product Managers can act on.

At its core, the job is analytical: you build the data foundation that shows how people really use KMD's products, where they get stuck and what to build or improve next. You decide what counts as solid evidence and make sure it reaches the right people, in the right shape, at the right time.

This is a hands-on role in our product portfolio governance team, where you'll work closely with product, tech and commercial leaders to make things happen.




Your tasks




Provide evidence-based input to product decisions by combining customer research, usage analytics, churn drivers and value-hypothesis testing, for both new product opportunities and improvements to existing ones
Identify usability issues, friction points and bottlenecks in the user journey, and surface them to product management with enough clarity and timing to act on
Turn validated insights into practical input for the roadmap
Own the metrics for usage, adoption and churn • Bring AI and new ways of working with product data insights to sharpen our understanding of users and set the standard for how PMs use it
Build scalable dashboards and reports together with the data team What you bring • Strong SQL and data modelling skills (e.g. star schemas) to build clean, reusable datasets
Hands-on experience extracting, transforming and loading data into Power BI (Power Query, DAX)

Title: Working in power markets? Let's talk
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Electricity Maps is building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. Real-time, historical, and forecasted electricity mix, prices, load, and carbon intensity across markets worldwide.

Power markets are a wide, fast-moving space and one with a lot of room for someone with the right experience to help shape what direction we take. That's why we'd rather meet you now even if we don't have an official role on the page. From there, we can figure out together what makes sense. We especially love hearing from people who come with a view: where you'd add value, what you'd want to work on or what you think we're missing.

Maybe you work in one of the following areas:


Day-ahead and intraday forecasting
BESS and asset optimization
Imbalance and balancing markets
Renewable generation forecasting (wind, solar, etc.)
Power market analytics or trading
Something adjacent


We're interested in talking across all lines of work in these areas: Engineering, ML, product, commercial, analytics, or something else. Whatever angle you come at it from, we're curious to hear it.

What to expect

We read every intro that comes through. If we see something we want to learn more about, we'll reach out to get to know each other and figure out together where your experience could add the most value.

About Electricity Maps

There are two sides to what we do. The first: decarbonizing the grid by making historical, real-time, and forecasted data on electricity mix, load, and carbon intensity available to anyone making smarter decisions across the energy transition.

The second is newer for us - we've started working with energy traders, asset operators, and BESS players in European power markets, building out price forecasting, market signals, and adjacent tooling. It's an area we're growing fast in and one with plenty of room for the right person to help shape where it goes.

The details


Location: Copenhagen (in-office with flexibility)
Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options (when a role materializes)
Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at office

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
To Good To Go: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Marketing Personalisation

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Hybrid)

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

We’re more than an app: we are a social impact company with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste. So alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 127 million registered users and 253,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already prevented 489+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.322.000 tonnes of CO2e!

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to be a part of our Consumer Growth Product and Tech team that defines, builds, and delivers AI features for our marketing personalization efforts. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best route to achieve them, collaborating with other engineers, data scientists, and product members. Within the Product & Tech organization, you will work toward generating the smartest possible recommendations for our users. Your work will ensure they are matched with the best meals at the right time, which in turn will result in more meals saved and improved user retention.

Your Mission

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering a step-change in personalization for our consumer marketplace. You will of course collaborate with your counterparts in other product teams, and will be part of the broader ML and tech communities at Too Good To Go. Your work will directly impact millions of users by improving our surplus food management solutions and personalizing their experience.

Tech Stack

Our models are written in Python, supported by SQL to retrieve data. Our models are built, evaluated, and productionised using our MLOps team's platform, which is based on Metaflow. The full Machine Learning stack includes: GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, Airflow, OpenSearch, and Redshift.

Responsibilities


Working on researching, building, and designing different machine-learning models for marketing personalization.
Running experiments, evaluating, and using the results to improve machine learning models and algorithms.
Working end-to-end to solve problems with a product and customer-oriented mindset.
Building and deploying models in production.
Involvement in developing statistical models.
Collaborating with the rest of the team to improve our product and solve customer problems.


The Ideal Candidate


Has established experience within a similar role.
Experience using Python and deploying to production.
First-hand experience with ML libraries, frameworks, and tools, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Prophet, DeepAR, etc.
Degree educated within a technical field (Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree).
Experience in a cloud environment (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Bonus: experience with dbt, Snowflake, Airflow, or Metaflow; experience in complex ML system design; and experience in statistical hypothesis testing.


What We Offer


Develop and maintain the backbone of our personalization engine, which is used by millions of users every day to support their efforts to combat food waste.
An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral member of our defined product teams. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the product scope and development; your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop, and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 20 countries.


Our values


We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers, and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving and want it to last.
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.


How To Apply


We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above.
Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
Please submit your CV and Cover letter in English.
Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer at Overstory, you will lead the development and scaling of our Wildfire Fuel Detection Model. This core engine powers how we understand vegetation structure, fuel loads, and wildfire risk from satellite and environmental data. You’ll help shape the next generation of Overstory’s modeling capabilities by combining cutting-edge ML techniques, large-scale geospatial data, and real-world domain expertise.

Reporting to our VP of Product Engineering, you’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to ensure our wildfire models are accurate, robust, and production-ready – balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering excellence. As a senior technical leader, you’ll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and define standards for modeling, experimentation, and deployment across Overstory.

Time zone requirement: Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You’ll Do

In collaboration with data, ML, and science colleagues, you will:


Architect and build advanced ML models to map and predict vegetation and fuel conditions across diverse geographies.
Design and maintain robust data and feature pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data.
Partner with wildfire science and product teams to define modeling objectives and evaluation metrics tied to real-world impact.
Build reproducible experimentation frameworks and model evaluation workflows.
Scale models from research to production with a focus on performance, reliability, and explainability.
Lead the evolution of ML systems, tooling, and processes — ensuring that our wildfire fuelscape models remain state-of-the-art and maintainable.
Collaborate with MLOps peers to streamline training, inference, and monitoring in production environments.


Skills & Experience


Experience thriving at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and environmental science; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk through data-driven insights
10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade ML pipelines and systems
You have a background in wildfire science, forestry, or remote sensing
Strong background in deep learning, computer vision, or remote sensing
Skilled in designing end-to-end ML systems — from data ingestion and preprocessing to deployment and monitoring
Hands-on experience with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or LightGBM, and data tools like Dask, Spark, or GeoPandas
Familiarity with GCP and Vertex AI, or similar cloud-based ML platforms
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and scientific domains
Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers


Nice To Have


Background in wildfire science, forestry, or remote sensing
Experience integrating physics-based models with ML or working with active learning and uncertainty quantification
Experience in model interpretability and data provenance for environmental ML systems
Experience with deep learning models for weather or climate data
Experience in remote-first or globally distributed teams

What We Offer


Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits
Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around
Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets
A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values
To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

Title: Quantitative Developer
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us in this role where you’ll ensure accurate and stable daily calculations for our gas portfolio. You’ll analyse and explain market-to-market values and risk metrics, helping colleagues understand portfolio performance and make well-informed commercial decisions.

Welcome to Structuring & Analysis

You’ll be part of Structuring & Analysis where you, together with your colleagues, will provide quantitative analysis and reliable calculations for the gas portfolio. You’ll work close to the trading business, and risk management colleagues, connecting technical results with daily commercial decisions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support each other, and take pride in delivering clear, dependable insights in a fast-moving environment.

You’ll play an important role in:


ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and operational stability of end-of-day calculations for the gas portfolio
analysing and explaining the market-to-market value of the portfolio and the factors driving changes
connecting portfolio results with risk metrics and explaining the calculations used in risk reporting
supporting the gas portfolio with day-to-day quantitative analysis and timely investigation of results
acting as a point of contact between the gas portfolio and development colleagues to improve tools and calculations
identifying opportunities to strengthen calculation processes, controls, and analytical quality.


To succeed in the role, you:


have a master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, finance, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience
apply mathematical and statistical knowledge to practical business questions and can investigate results with accuracy and attention to detail
have programming experience and can work confidently with financial domain specific languages, quantitative models, and calculation tools
communicate complex technical concepts clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical colleagues
work well with stakeholders in a fast-moving environment, respond constructively when priorities change, and take ownership of issues
have knowledge of European gas markets or experience in a desk quant, trading, portfolio, or risk environment, or are motivated to develop this knowledge.


Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

 

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

 

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

 

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr51,440.00- kr77,160.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Description:
3Shape and DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science at the Technical University of Denmark) invite applications for an Industrial Postdoctoral position partially funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The position is a 2-year fixed-term appointment starting in January 2027 (small variations in the start date may be possible depending on the candidate’s preference).




The project addresses a fundamental challenge in computational imaging and large-scale optimization: how can uncertainty in measurements be quantified, propagated, and ultimately leveraged to improve the reliability of reconstructed 3d models?




Modern 3D scanning systems rely on advanced optimization algorithms to reconstruct geometry and color from large volumes of sensor data. While these algorithms produce highly accurate results, they typically provide limited information about the confidence and uncertainty associated with the reconstructed output. Developing methods that can efficiently estimate and propagate uncertainty in the input data through large-scale iterative optimization algorithms has the potential to improve reconstruction quality, enable more informed algorithmic decisions, and support the next generation of intelligent scanning systems.




The successful candidate will conduct research at the intersection of numerical linear algebra, optimization, uncertainty quantification, and computational imaging. The project will investigate: (i) how to characterize measurement uncertainty, (ii) how uncertainty propagates through iterative solvers, (iii) how to develop new mathematical frameworks for uncertainty-aware optimization, and (iv) how to validate the proposed methods through simulations and deployment in medical 3D reconstruction algorithms developed at 3Shape.




The position offers a unique opportunity to combine fundamental research with industrial impact. Working closely with leading researchers at DTU and engineers at 3Shape, the candidate will contribute to scientific publications, software prototype development, and innovation activities aimed at strengthening the theoretical foundations and practical performance of future 3D scanning technologies.




About us

At 3Shape we aim to advance dental treatment and diagnostics with advanced software and 3D scanners designed for dental professionals across the globe. Our purpose is to advance innovation in dentistry, continuously enhancing patient care and outcomes.




This role places you at the heart of our technological advancements within Product Creation, namely TRIOS & SCANNER SW, offering the chance to shape the trajectory of our innovative products and software applications.




About the project

The project is a 2-year project between 3Shape and the Technical University of Denmark, partly funded by Innovation Fund Denmark. The academic co-supervisor will be Professor Per Christian Hansen at DTU Compute (Department of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science).




The research focuses on uncertainty-aware methods for large-scale linear least squares problems, which form the mathematical backbone of many inverse problems and optimization tasks in 3D reconstruction. The objective is to develop new theoretical and computational tools for quantifying and propagating uncertainty through iterative solution methods, and to translate these developments into practical algorithms for medical 3D reconstruction systems.




What You’ll Do

In this role, you will contribute both to the theoretical foundation and the practical implementation of next-generation uncertainty-aware reconstruction algorithms. The work spans mathematical modelling, algorithm design, and software development in a medical imaging 3D reconstruction.

You will:

Develop methods for characterizing measurement uncertainty in medical 3D scanning data, including data-driven approaches and machine learning methods where appropriate, to obtain realistic and application-relevant uncertainty models.
Work hands-on with numerical algorithms, including iterative methods such as Krylov subspace methods and related solvers.
Develop and analyse new methods for uncertainty-aware linear least squares optimization, with a focus on large-scale iterative solvers.
Design mathematical frameworks for quantifying how uncertainty evolves through optimization algorithms used in 3D reconstruction.
Contribute to the architectural design of uncertainty-aware components within existing reconstruction pipelines.
Translate theoretical models into efficient, scalable implementations suitable for industrial use.
Design and run simulation studies to validate theoretical developments under realistic conditions.
Collaborate with researchers and engineers to integrate new methods into production-oriented 3D scanning systems.
Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, technical reports, and potential patentable innovations.




What We’re Looking For

A PhD in Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. The PhD must have been awarded after March 2021 (or will be obtained within November 2026).
Strong expertise in numerical linear algebra, optimization, and/or inverse problems.
Solid understanding of linear least squares methods and iterative solvers, ideally methods based on Krylov subspace methods.
Experience with or strong interest in uncertainty quantification, statistical modelling, or probabilistic methods.
Strong programming skills in at least one programming language (ideally two), such as C#, C++, or Python.
Familiarity with machine learning methods is an advantage, particularly for data-driven modelling of complex systems.
Ability to work independently and take ownership of research problems while also contributing to a collaborative industrial-academic environment.
Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex mathematical ideas clearly in both academic and applied settings.




What 3Shape offers

A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and collaborative colleagues - we are more than 50 nationalities in our DK based office
Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.
We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.
Good work/life balance.
Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.
Purpose: Endeavor to improve dental patients on a global scale.




Staying true to our values and D&I efforts, we encourage all relevant applicants to apply, and we ask you NOT to add any photos or sensitive information (age, marital status, nationality) during the application process.




We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

Title: Senior Quantitative UX Researcher
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

We’re a leading online reviews platform, free and open to all. Our mission is to be a universal symbol of trust. We are well on our way - but there’s still an exciting journey ahead of us. Do you want to join us at the heart of trust?

We’re currently looking for a Senior UX researcher to join our team at Trustpilot.

Our goal is simple: to become the most trusted reviews platform in the world. We will achieve this by being ready and willing to disrupt ourselves through innovation, data and insight and adding product professionals with ambitions that match our own.

As Senior UX Researcher, you'll be the go-to expert on measuring how people and businesses experience trust on Trustpilot , from reading a review to deciding our platform is worth paying for. You'll own the quantitative research agenda for your product areas, set the bar for statistical rigour across the team, and partner with Data Science to build a shared measurement culture.

 

What you'll be doing:


Research strategy & execution

Design and own the quantitative research roadmap for your product areas, e.g.  attitudinal measurement, behavioural analysis, and longitudinal tracking.
Lead large-scale surveys (validated scales, NPS derivatives, trust-perception metrics) and log-data/behavioural analytics (funnels, A/B tests, cohort and retention modelling).
Build measurement frameworks that define what ‘good’ looks like for review-reading, purchase-decision, and business-subscription journeys  and track them over time.


Quantitative methods

Lead advanced quantitative research - surveys, behavioural analytics, experimentation, predictive modelling  using statistical rigor as the throughline, from validated instrument design through to automated, auditable analysis pipelines (Python/R/SQL).
Pioneer AI-assisted techniques (e.g. LLM-assisted open-text analysis) where they genuinely sharpen the work, evaluating any AI tooling with a critical eye on validity and bias.


Standards, influence and coaching

Partner with Data Science and Analytics on shared definitions and data pipelines; hold the bar on study design and statistical rigour across the team.
Translate statistical output into clear, decision-forcing narratives that PMs, designers, and engineers act on.
Coach other researchers in quantitative methods, raising the team's statistical literacy through pairing and structured feedback.

 

What we're looking for:

4+ years of UX research experience with a strong specialisation in quantitative methods and complex, broad-scope work.
Strong survey methodology (instrument design, sampling, psychometric validation) and statistical grounding (regression, factor/cluster analysis, significance testing).
Hands-on proficiency in Python, R, or SQL, and direct experience with large behavioural datasets (e.g. Amplitude, Looker, BigQuery).
A track record of quant research that measurably shaped product or business decisions, including A/B testing methodology.
Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools in a research workflow  e.g. LLM-assisted analysis, AI-assisted qual coding, or evaluating AI-powered research tooling  with a critical eye on validity and bias.
AI-curious practitioner who can speak critically about AI's limits as well as its power; collaborates fluently with qual, data science, and product analysts.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work closely with diverse teams and present data-driven findings in an engaging and accessible way.

 

What’s in it for you:

A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
Competitive compensation package + bonus
25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated) 
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist
Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave
Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials
Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms 
Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York. 

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas. 

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com) quoting the role you wish to apply for.
