Title: Join Halfspace’s AI & Advanced Analytics Team - Shaping the Future with AI
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Who We Are

At Halfspace, Part of Accenture - Center for Advanced AI - we believe that the smallest edge can make the biggest difference. We began in sports, predicting outcomes in live football matches, and today we bring that same precision and ambition into the world of business. We're here to unlock value through artificial intelligence and help organisations make better, more informed decisions, faster.

With more than one hundred AI and data projects delivered, our work has transformed industries and earned international recognition. But awards and numbers tell only part of the story. What truly defines us is our people. Our team comes from leading institutions such as KU, DTU, Stanford, Oxford, Harvard, Caltech, Yale, Colombia and many more, blending expertise in physics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, operations research, computer science, chemistry, economics, biology, design and strategy. Together, we share curiosity, boldness, and a pioneering spirit.

Halfspace is a specialized spearheading unit within Accenture, focused on bringing the deepest expertise in applied AI. We are 'Inch Wide - Mile Deep' in our capabilities.

What You'll Be Doing

As part of the AI & Advanced Analytics team at Halfspace, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of artificial intelligence — designing, building, and deploying systems that push what’s possible. You’ll contribute to the development of intelligent agents, generative AI models, and advanced analytical frameworks that deliver real-world impact across industries.

You’ll work alongside engineers, scientists, and strategists from some of the world’s leading institutions, applying deep technical expertise and creative thinking to solve complex problems. From prototyping novel AI applications to operationalizing models at scale, you’ll bridge research and engineering to turn ideas into solutions that redefine performance.

Every experiment, model, and insight you create will help organizations make better decisions, faster — embodying our mission to deliver the smallest edge that makes the biggest difference.

Who We're Looking For

We’re looking for curious and technically exceptional individuals who live at the intersection of AI, mathematics, and software. You combine a strong foundation in statistical modeling and machine learning with the creativity and rigor to turn theory into working systems.

You’re fluent in Python and comfortable working with modern AI stacks — whether that means fine-tuning large language models, architecting agentic systems, or building robust analytical pipelines.

For our Generative AI unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core AI libraries

Experience working with integrating Generative AI and developing AI Agents or other applications

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



For our Advanced Analytics unit we value:



Strong proficiency in Python and core ML libraries

Solid understanding of statistical modeling, optimization, and experimental design

Familiarity with MLOps and model deployment practices

Intellectual curiosity, precision, and a pioneering mindset — the qualities that define Halfspace



If you have less than two years of professional experience, please include your academic transcripts with your application.

Life at Halfspace, part of Accenture

We think and act like a professional sports team. We value flexibility, trust, and balance. We invest in learning and development to keep our team ahead of the curve on everything AI. And we create an environment where ambitious people can grow while working on projects that matter, side by side with some of the world’s leading companies and greatest minds.

About Halfspace, Part Of Accenture

Halfspace was established in 2015. We're on a mission to bring the power of artificial intelligence to industry and deliver exceptional quality and value, whenever we engage, while creating a space which attracts the brightest, most curious and most talented people. As of March 2025 Halfspace became a part of Accenture to help build and grow the Accenture Center for Advanced AI across the Nordics and EMEA.

Title: Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join Copenhagen Energy Trading as our next Quantitative Researcher - Algorithmic Trading (Short-term Power Markets)

Copenhagen Energy Trading (CET) shapes the future of the energy transition by combining deep market expertise with technical excellence in data, quantitative research and engineering to drive, automate and optimise our trading operations.




We’re a small, elite team based in central Copenhagen specializing in power trading and asset management across Europe and North America. Technology is core to how we operate, powered by exceptional talent and one of Europe’s most advanced automated and analytical trading environments for power markets. But we're not done. We want to push automation and advanced analytics even further, and to do that we need more exceptional people.




The Opportunity

That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an outstanding Quantitative Researcher with a proven track record of building real-time algorithmic trading strategies that operate with high reliability in regulated industries. You'll play a key role in developing strategies for the European short-term power markets.




This isn't a narrow coding or analyst role. You'll have an end-to-end mandate, from prototyping and data engineering to strategy implementation, backtesting and low-latency execution in our algorithmic trading framework. Title: Vil du hjælpe os med at udvikle FREMTIDENS KVÆGAVL?
Description:
Brænder du for data og statistik, og synes du koen er et fantastisk dyr? Vil du være med til at udvikle et mere bæredygtigt kvægbrug i Danmark? Så er du måske den kollega, vi leder efter til et spændende job i SEGES Innovation.




I SEGES Innovation tilbyder vi dig en karriere med mening. Vores innovation og viden gør en forskel både i hverdagen og på den lange bane. Vores specialister arbejder med alt fra klima og miljø, planter, dyr og digitale løsninger til vækst og vidensformidling. Sammen bidrager vi til de løsninger, der gør landbruget og fødevareproduktionen endnu mere bæredygtig.




I afdelingen for Husdyr søger vi lige nu en person med en uddannelse inden for agrobiologi, statistik, matematik, data science eller lignende. Din uddannelsesbaggrund er dog ikke det vigtigste. Det vigtigste er, at du har stærke analytiske evner, interesse for data og lyst til at være med til at udvikle grundlaget for avlsarbejdet med kvæg i Danmark og Norden.




Hvad skal du lave?

Som vores nye kollega bliver du en del af den afdeling, der har ansvar for udvikling og drift af avlsværdivurdering for malkekvæg, kødkvæg, får og geder. Vi er ni personer, der arbejder tæt sammen om alt fra indsamling af data på den enkelte ko til implementering af avancerede statistiske modeller. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver og projekter, men vi bruger aktivt hinandens viden og kompetencer. Vi har nemlig som regel travlt, og vores erfaring er, at vi når længst gennem samarbejde.




Dit arbejdsområde vil primært være udviklingsprojekter, hvor vi udvikler de avlsværdital, som landmænd og avlsorganisationer bruger til at vælge de bedste avlsdyr som forældre til næste generation. Det kan for eksempel være avlsværdital for reduceret metanudledning eller egenskaber, der forbedrer dyrevelfærd og sygdomsresistens. Grundlaget er store mængder data fra blandt andet genomiske tests og målinger på køer og kalve.




Noget af det, vi selv synes er allerbedst ved vores arbejde, er muligheden for at være med til at forme fremtidens projekter og faglige fokusområder. Derfor er opsamling, udvikling og prioritering af nye idéer en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Samtidig motiverer det os at se, at det vi udvikler, bliver anvendt i praksis hos landmændene og gør en reel forskel.




En typisk hverdag

Vi er praktiske talnørder, og vores projekter har typisk en varighed på 1 til 4 år. En normal arbejdsdag starter ofte med statistiske analyser eller udviklingsopgaver. Vi arbejder tæt sammen som gruppe og har faste morgenmøder tre gange om ugen, hvor vi kort deler status på vores opgaver og eventuelle udfordringer.




Selvom du har dine egne ansvarsområder, er der altid en erfaren kollega at sparre med, og Teams bliver flittigt brugt til både store og små spørgsmål i løbet af dagen. Efterhånden som du opbygger erfaring, vil du også få dialog med avlsrådgivere og landmænd samt mulighed for at præsentere resultater og anbefalinger.




Du får dermed en varieret hverdag med mulighed for både fordybelse, faglig udvikling og samarbejde.




Projektporteføljen for 2026 og 2027 er allerede fastlagt, men vi har gode muligheder for at tilpasse dele af opgaverne efter dine interesser og kompetencer.




Vi drømmer om, at du

Har lyst til at analysere store datasæt.
Har lyst til at udvikle nye idéer og eventuelt lede udviklingsprojekter.
Kan kommunikere klart og præcist, både mundtligt og skriftligt.
Kan programmere i SAS eller Python eller har lyst til at lære det.
Har interesse for dataanalyse og lyst til at lære mere om kvægproduktion og avl.




Det får du hos os

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø med mulighed for at udvikle dig inden for statistiske modeller, programmering, projektledelse og formidling af komplekse analyser.




Når du starter, har vi en plan klar for både din introduktion til gruppens arbejde og dine første opgaver på kort og længere sigt. Du får tilknyttet en kollega, som sikrer, at du kommer godt i gang.




Har du ikke et indgående kendskab til kvæg, er det ikke noget problem. Vi hjælper dig med at opbygge den nødvendige forståelse, og hvis du har lyst, sender vi dig gerne på besøg i en besætning, så du får et godt indblik i branchen og de problemstillinger, vi arbejder med.




Praktiske oplysninger

Ansættelse ønskes snarest muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anders Fogh på telefon 51 73 73 23.




Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde en ny kollega velkommen i arbejdet med at udvikle fremtidens bæredygtige kvægbrug.










Ved rekruttering hos SEGES Innovation prioriterer vi primært din faglige ekspertise og personlighed. Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke, derfor opfordres alle med de rette kompetencer til at søge - uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, kønsidentitet og alder.




SEGES Innovation er en uafhængig forsknings- og innovationsvirksomhed, der arbejder for en bæredygtig og konkurrencedygtig landbrugs- og fødevareproduktion. Vi kobler faglige indsigter med digitale teknologier, så ny viden kommer ud at virke i stalden, på marken og i hele værdikæden fra jord til bord.




Vores mange forskellige eksperter udgør et unikt fagmiljø i international topklasse med ca. 500 dedikerede kolleger, der arbejder ud fra værdierne Mod, Hjerte og Dybde og i tæt samspil med Danmarks mere end 30.000 landbrug, universiteter og uddannelsesinstitutioner, landbrugsrådgivere, fødevareproducenter, energiselskaber og myndigheder.

Description:
Job Description

Are you interested in applying your data, engineering, cloud, or AI expertise within the Life Sciences industry? We are always looking for talented professionals to join the project teams driving this work forward.

At ADC, our Engineering & Analytics (Life Sciences) team is engaged across the full R&D data value chain for pharmaceutical and biotech organisations, from early discovery through clinical development. Our work spans scientific data engineering and GenAI solutions across omics, molecular data and AI engineering. We're also delivering data products and GenAI capabilities that support clinical development and operations within regulated LS environments.

How This Connects To Our Current Work

Our team is actively working across the following areas within Life Sciences:


Omics engineering: building scientific data engineering and GenAI solutions across omics, molecular data and AI engineering, including data-analysis platforms.
Bioinformatics: delivering end-to-end AI solutions built on industry best practices, combining deep domain knowledge with engineering excellence for clinical and biological data.
Clinical data engineering: working with synthetic data flows, clinical data platforms and pipelines, and driving coding best practices in clinical development.
LLM and generative AI applications in pharma: having hands-on experience building agentic and LLM-based products in regulated environments such as Databricks and Azure OpenAI.
Data engineering: building and maintaining pipelines and migration engineering that regulated enterprise rollouts depend on.


We welcome applications from all seniority levels, from junior professionals to experienced specialists and senior consultants.

What You'd Be Working On

Our teams are currently working on a wide range of projects, including:


Clinical, biomedical, omics, or pharmaceutical data
Reliable and scalable data pipelines
Cloud and data platforms such as Databricks
Technologies such as Python, SQL, Spark, and MLflow
Machine learning, LLMs, or generative AI within Life Sciences
Bioinformatics or computational biology solutions


What Happens After You Apply

We'll review your profile, and if it matches what we're currently working on, we'll reach out for an introductory conversation. As this pipeline is intended for future hiring and project needs, there is no specific timeline associated with the application.


Amsterdam Data Collective is an equal opportunity employer. To shape a better future, we value diversity and promote equality. No characteristics are discriminated against, as indicated in Directive 2000/78/EC. We encourage and welcome all applications. Additional arrangements or adjustments to support your application can be discussed further.

Title: Quantitative Analyst
Description:
Do you want to gain a deep understanding of the power market and contribute directly to trading decisions? Do you thrive in a high‑paced, data‑driven environment where your analytical skills shape tomorrow’s strategies? If you’re ready for a role with real responsibility and impact, join our team as a Quantitative Analyst and help drive disciplined, high‑quality trading outcomes.




We are seeking a highly motivated individual with strong quantitative skills to join our team as a Quantitative Analyst. In this role, you will work closely with the team, applying data‑driven insights, modelling, and risk thinking to take ownership of disciplined trading decisions. Your ability to transform analysis and code into actionable insights will directly contribute to improving the quality and profitability of our trading decisions.




In this role, you will gain deep insights into our trading strategies and tools that provide a significant competitive advantage. You can expect a steep learning curve and growth opportunities in an environment where flat hierarchy and team spirit drive our success. You will experience a high degree of autonomy and see your own ideas come to life and see your ideas quickly evolve into tangible solutions that make a meaningful impact on our trading operations.




Key Responsibilities

Market Analysis: Conduct in-depth, data‑driven analysis of power markets including supply and demand fundamentals, regulatory developments, weather‑driven patterns, and geopolitical impacts to uncover actionable trading opportunities and support strategic decision‑making.
Risk Management: Implement robust risk management practices by monitoring position limits, conducting stress testing, and assessing exposure to volatile market conditions to ensure controlled and compliant trading activities.
Tool Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize a range of analytical, real‑time monitoring, and reporting tools that enhance trading decision‑making and operational efficiency. Build automated dashboards and data pipelines to produce accurate, timely reports on trading performance, risk metrics, and key market trends.
Model Development: Continuously improve trading models through back testing and market‑driven data analysis to strengthen and support profitable trading decisions.
Collaboration: Work closely with the team to enhance trading strategies and technical setup, ensuring clear and consistent communication across all team members.
Trading Application: Apply insights from analysis, modelling and risk assessment to confidently support and execute well‑founded trading decisions that meet all required risk, compliance, and performance standards.




Qualifications and Requirements

As a candidate, we expect you:

Hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mathematics‑economics, economics, statistics, engineering, or another quantitative field.
Have strong quantitative and analytical skills to interpret complex data and translate it into well‑founded trading insights.
Are proficient in Python and comfortable with coding. Experience with other code languages is considered an advantage.
Have a strong interest in financial and energy markets and a desire to deepen your understanding of power‑market dynamics.
Demonstrate excellent problem‑solving skills, high attention to detail, and the ability to adapt quickly to changing market conditions.
Communicate clearly and effectively, presenting technical and analytical concepts in a way that is easy for both technical and non‑technical team members to understand.




What We Offer

As an employer, we offer:

A full-time position that gives you the opportunity to apply your acquired skills.
Support in your role from experienced professionals.
Access to unique technologies and resources.
An opportunity to work at the forefront of power trading, contributing to groundbreaking strategies.
Opportunities for career growth and advancement.
Competitive compensation package.
A modern and brand-new office in the heart of Aarhus.
Professional and committed colleagues with high ambitions.
Inspiring, collaborative, and innovative work environment.
A place where your contributions are recognized and have a meaningful impact on the company's success.




A Profitable Growth Company with a Clear Vision

ENZEE is an ambitious growth company specialized in energy trading across the European continent. We envision a sustainable world and therefore, every day at ENZEE is a day with purpose. We believe that well-functioning and efficient energy markets are a necessity towards a net zero future which is exactly where we contribute with our expertise.




The ENZEE team consists of highly qualified, experienced, and knowledgeable industry professionals with a wide range of expertise in the energy markets. As a member of our team, you can expect a steep learning curve, great career growth opportunities, and the possibility of making a significant contribution.




Jobstart & Type

Full-time position
Location: Aarhus
As soon as possible




Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, and we encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Title: AI engineer til Forsvarets AI Center
Place: Kongens Lyngby, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Kan du forklare attention på en serviet, træne en transformer fra bunden, og bygge de evals, der afslører, om den faktisk virker? Og vil du bruge dine evner på noget, der virkelig betyder noget? Så har vi en mission, adgang til Danmarks nationale AI-supercomputer, og en plads til dig, uanset om du lige har afleveret specialet eller har nogle år på bagen.




Om os

AI ændrer allerede rammerne for samfund, sikkerhedspolitik, og militær opgaveløsning. Fremtidens kampplads vil i stigende grad være præget af data, autonomi, og hurtigere beslutningsprocesser. Forsvarets AI Center (FAIC) er etableret som ny enhed i Forsvarskommandoen for at sikre, at AI omsættes til reel dansk og allieret forsvarsevne.




FAIC sætter retning på Forsvarets brug af AI - fra doktrin til operationel virkelighed. Vi opbygger institutionel kompetence, indgår partnerskaber med NATO, allierede, akademia, og industri, og definerer de operative behov og principper som Forsvarets AI-løsninger udvikles og anskaffes ud fra - i tæt samarbejde med Forsvarets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI), så anskaffelser og leverancer tager udgangspunkt i soldaternes behov og Forsvarets kerneopgave. Vores samarbejde med Gefion, Danmarks nationale AI-supercomputer, viser arbejdsformen: åbne miljøer giver læring og tempo, mens lukkede rammer sikrer militær anvendelse hvor sikkerhed, klassifikation, og operativ relevans er afgørende.




FAIC er stedet hvor Forsvarets AI-fremtid formes. Vi søger erfarne profiler der vil være med fra dag ét.




Om stillingen




Som AI Engineer i Forsvarets AI Center arbejder du med at udvikle, tilpasse og evaluere AI-modeller til Forsvarets operative behov. Du træner og finetuner modeller på Gefion og arbejder med alt fra transformerarkitekturer, attention-mekanismer og optimering til evaluering af modellers præcision, robusthed og sikkerhed. Du udvikler de værktøjer, evalueringsmetoder og sikkerhedsmekanismer, der gør det muligt at vurdere, om en model er klar til operativ anvendelse. Samtidig bygger du datapipelines, testværktøjer og softwareintegrationer og samarbejder tæt med udviklere, platform engineers og operative brugere om at omsætte forskning til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.




Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt miljø med en stejl læringskurve, hvor både nyuddannede og erfarne kan udvikle sig fagligt og bidrage med deres kompetencer.




Rollen er for dig, der er nysgerrig på den nyeste AI-forskning, motiveres af at forstå, hvorfor modeller opfører sig, som de gør, og vil bruge din tekniske viden til at styrke Forsvarets opgaveløsning




Dine Vigtigste Opgaver:




Modeludvikling og træning:




Du træner, finetuner og tilpasser AI-modeller til Forsvarets opgaver og data, herunder sprogmodeller, multimodale modeller og modeller til sensor- og billeddata. Du eksperimenterer med transformerarkitekturer, attention-mekanismer og andre effektive modelstrukturer samt anvender metoder som supervised fine-tuning, preference-optimering og reinforcement learning til at forme modellernes adfærd. På Gefion og AI Centerets øvrige GPU-ressourcer optimerer du træningsforløb med fokus på effektivitet og stabilitet. Du opbygger og kvalitetssikrer samtidig trænings- og evalueringsdata, herunder syntetiske data, med fokus på kvalitet, sporbarhed og klassifikation.




Evals, guardrails, og tillid:




Du udvikler evalueringsmetoder og benchmarks, der måler modellernes præcision, robusthed og pålidelighed i relevante operative scenarier. Du implementerer guardrails, der understøtter sikker og forudsigelig modeladfærd, også ved prompt injection og andre adversarielle angreb. Gennem red teaming og fejlanalyse identificerer du svagheder og dokumenterer resultaterne, så der er et solidt grundlag for at vurdere, om modellerne er klar til anvendelse. Du bidrager desuden til forklarlighed og ansvarlig brug af AI i overensstemmelse med Forsvarets og NATOs principper.




Inferens og deployment:




Du udvikler inferens-harnesses og evalueringspipelines, der gør det muligt at teste, sammenligne og validere modeller systematisk og reproducerbart. Du optimerer modeller til praktisk anvendelse gennem blandt andet kvantisering, destillation og effektiv serving, så de kan køre på begrænset hardware og i afskærmede miljøer. I samarbejde med udviklere og platform engineers bidrager du til at bringe modeller sikkert fra udvikling til klassificerede driftsmiljøer efter princippet develop low, deploy high.




Tværfaglighed og bredde:




Du udvikler komponenter, services og værktøjer, der understøtter modeludviklingen, herunder dataindlæsning, API'er, integrationer og brugerflader til test og demonstration. Du vedligeholder datapipelines og testdata, der gør udviklingsprocessen mere effektiv og pålidelig, og samarbejder med udviklere, platform engineers, dataspecialister og operative brugere om at føre løsninger fra idé til anvendelse. Du tager ansvar for de opgaver, der skal løses undervejs, tilegner dig løbende nye kompetencer og deler din viden med teamet.




Forskning og samarbejde:




Du følger den internationale AI-forskning og omsætter relevante resultater til konkrete løsninger for Forsvaret. Med udgangspunkt i matematisk modellering, statistik og optimering undersøger du komplekse problemstillinger og vurderer, hvilke modeller og metoder der bedst løser opgaven. Du samarbejder med forskningsmiljøer, industrien, NATO og allierede om modeludvikling og erfaringsudveksling. Derudover udarbejder du tekniske analyser og anbefalinger, der understøtter Forsvarets beslutninger, og bidrager til at opbygge organisationens AI-kompetencer gennem vidensdeling, faglig sparring og mentorering.




Vi tilbyder et job med en mission: Du hjælper Forsvaret med at tage AI i brug, får adgang til Danmarks nationale AI-supercomputer, arbejder med problemer, man ikke finder andre steder, og bliver en del af et team, hvor nyuddannede og erfarne lærer af hinanden og bygger Forsvarets egen AI-kompetence op fra bunden.




Om dig




Du har en kandidat- eller ph.d.-grad inden for machine learning, datalogi, matematik, fysik, statistik eller en tilsvarende kvantitativ retning. Du er nyuddannet eller har erfaring fra forskning eller praksis, hvor du har arbejdet med at træne og finetune deep learning-modeller – gerne sprogmodeller eller andre transformerbaserede modeller.




Du har en solid forståelse af transformerarkitekturer, attention-mekanismer og den matematik, der ligger bag moderne deep learning, herunder lineær algebra, sandsynlighedsregning og optimering. Du har desuden kendskab til evaluering af modeller, inferens-harnesses og guardrails og forholder dig kritisk til, hvad benchmarks reelt måler. Du er stærk i Python og PyTorch eller tilsvarende frameworks og skriver kode, der er reproducerbar og kan bruges af andre.




Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø og har lyst til at arbejde bredt med AI – også med de opgaver, der ligger rundt om modellerne, såsom komponentudvikling, databehandling og integrationer. Du motiveres af en klar mission og ønsker at bruge dine tekniske kompetencer til at styrke Danmarks og NATOs forsvar. Du behersker både dansk og engelsk i en professionel kontekst.




Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du også har erfaring med et eller flere af følgende områder:




Distribueret træning: Træning på GPU-klynger med fx Slurm, FSDP, DeepSpeed eller Megatron.
Modeloptimering: Preference-optimering og reinforcement learning, fx DPO eller RLHF.
Effektiv inferens: Kvantisering, destillation eller værktøjer som vLLM, TensorRT og CUDA.
AI-sikkerhed: Mechanistic interpretability, red teaming eller andre metoder til at undersøge og forbedre modellers sikkerhed.
Multimodale modeller: Modeller til sensor-, billed- eller geodata.
Forskning og open source: Publicering af forskning eller bidrag til open source-projekter inden for machine learning.
Forsvar og myndigheder: Erfaring fra forsvars-, efterretnings- eller myndighedskontekst, herunder arbejde i klassificerede miljøer.




Ansættelsesvilkår




Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Der forhandles kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg efter relevant erfaring og kompetencer. Derudover er der til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.




Arbejdsstedet er i Lyngby.




Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.




Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.




Kontakt og ansøgning

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Rasmus Kilmose på telefon 2262 8836.




Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Madeleine Moltke Kæmsgaard på telefon 4031 1094.




Ansøgningsfristen er den 30. november 2026 og samtaler bliver afholdt løbende. Stillingen er til besættelse snarest muligt efter aftale.




Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.




I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.




Om Forsvarets AI-center

AI er ved at omdefinere både kamppladsen og den måde, Forsvaret skaber og anvender kampkraft. AI forkorter vejen fra observation til beslutning og virkning og åbner for opgaveløsninger, der ikke tidligere var mulige. AI er ikke noget, der blot understøtter Forsvarets operationer — AI er med til at definere dem. Det er derfor, AI har en central plads i Forsvaret, og det er derfor, Forsvarets AI-Center (FAIC) er etableret som ny enhed i Forsvarskommandoen.




FAIC sætter retning for, hvordan Forsvaret anvender AI, så investeringer omsættes til reel dansk og allieret forsvarsevne. Vi prioriterer operative behov på tværs af værn og kommandoer i tæt dialog med operatørerne, og vi opbygger partnerskaber med NATO, allierede, akademia og industri. Vores opgave er at sikre, at AI bliver til kampkraft — ikke teknologi for teknologiens skyld.




Vi arbejder AI-først og innovativt nok til at ændre os, mens virkeligheden ændrer sig. Det betyder korte cyklusser, tæt på operatøren, og tempo og læring som operative krav. Vi udvikler i åbne miljøer for at få fart og indsigt, og vi tager løsninger i drift i klassificerede miljøer, hvor sikkerhed og operativ relevans er afgørende. Vi har adgang til noget af Nordens bedste computer, og vores infrastruktur er bygget til, at AI er en del af løsningen fra start.




Forsvarets AI-Center er stedet, hvor Forsvarets AI-fremtid formes.

AI forkorter vejen fra observation til beslutning og virkning og åbner for opgaveløsninger, der ikke tidligere var mulige. AI er ikke noget, der blot understøtter Forsvarets operationer — AI er med til at definere dem. Det er derfor, AI har en central plads i Forsvaret, og det er derfor, Forsvarets AI-Center (FAIC) er etableret som ny enhed i Forsvarskommandoen.


FAIC sætter retning for, hvordan Forsvaret anvender AI, så investeringer omsættes til reel dansk og allieret forsvarsevne. Vi prioriterer operative behov på tværs af værn og kommandoer i tæt dialog med operatørerne, og vi opbygger partnerskaber med NATO, allierede, akademia og industri. Vores opgave er at sikre, at AI bliver til kampkraft — ikke teknologi for teknologiens skyld.


Vi arbejder AI-først og innovativt nok til at ændre os, mens virkeligheden ændrer sig. Det betyder korte cyklusser, tæt på operatøren, og tempo og læring som operative krav. Vi udvikler i åbne miljøer for at få fart og indsigt, og vi tager løsninger i drift i klassificerede miljøer, hvor sikkerhed og operativ relevans er afgørende. Vi har adgang til noget af Nordens bedste computer, og vores infrastruktur er bygget til, at AI er en del af løsningen fra start.


Forsvarets AI-Center er stedet, hvor Forsvarets AI-fremtid formes.

Title: Bliv AI-løsningsudvikler i vores nye AI-enhed
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Byg AI-løsninger, der virker i virkeligheden

En AI-løsning kan se fantastisk ud i en demo og stadig fejle, når den møder virkeligheden. Hos Trafikstyrelsen får du mulighed for at udvikle løsninger, hvor AI er en central del af funktionaliteten – og følge dem fra idé og eksperiment til løsninger, der kan anvendes i praksis.

Vær med til at bygge vores AI Lab

Du bliver en del af IT og Digitalisering, hvor vi er ved at etablere et nyt AI Lab. Du kommer derfor ind i et område under opbygning og får mulighed for at præge både vores løsninger og måden, vi kommer til at arbejde med AI på. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med Trafikstyrelsens fagområder om at finde de steder, hvor AI kan skabe reel værdi.

Sådan bliver din hverdag hos os

Du Arbejder Tæt Sammen Med Fagkontorerne Om At Forstå Deres Arbejdsgange Og Problemer Og Omsætte Dem Til Løsninger, Hvor AI Anvendes, Når Det Giver Mening. Det Kan Være Generativ AI, Men Også Analyse Af Dokumenter Og Billeder, Informationsudtræk Eller Klassifikation. Du Arbejder Fra De Første Prototyper Til Løsninger, Der Kan Integreres Med Vores Systemer, Testes Og Fungere Stabilt i Praksis. Dine Vigtigste Opgaver Bliver At


udvikle og vedligeholde løsninger, hvor AI indgår som en central del.
afprøve forskellige AI-metoder og omsætte de gode prototyper til robuste løsninger.
integrere AI med eksisterende systemer, data og arbejdsgange.
evaluere kvalitet, fejl og usikkerhed systematisk.
sikre en sikker og ansvarlig anvendelse af AI.


Hvad skal du kunne?

Du Har Et Solidt Fundament Inden For Softwareudvikling Og Kan Tage Ansvar For Dine Løsninger Og Arbejde Selvstændigt i Et Område Under Opbygning. Det Er Et Krav, At Du Har En Relevant Teknisk Kandidatuddannelse Inden For Fx Datalogi, Data Science, Kunstig Intelligens, Softwareudvikling Eller Tilsvarende. Vi Lægger Vægt På, At Du


kan programmere og integrere AI med eksisterende systemer og datakilder.
har praktisk erfaring med forskellige AI-teknologier og -metoder, f.eks. generativ AI, dokument- og billedanalyse, informationsudtræk eller klassifikation.
har arbejdet med sprogmodeller og relevante AI-mønstre som RAG og agentbaserede løsninger.
kan evaluere og teste AI-løsninger og forholde dig til kvalitet, fejl og usikkerhed i resultaterne.
forstår betydningen af data, sikkerhed og guardrails, når AI indgår i løsninger.


Vi forventer, at du har praktisk erfaring med at bygge AI-løsninger og har arbejdet med flere af de nævnte teknologier og metoder. Du behøver ikke være specialist i dem alle, men du skal have en bred forståelse af AI og kunne vurdere, hvilken tilgang der passer til problemet. Du tager naturligt initiativ til dialog på tværs af organisationen. Du opsøger kolleger, deler idéer og erfaringer og er nysgerrig på deres arbejde og udfordringer. Du har lyst til at formidle mulighederne med AI – både i den direkte dialog og på skrift – og trives med, at en væsentlig del af jobbet foregår ude blandt kollegerne og ikke kun foran skærmen.

Det får du hos os

Når vi siger, at vi er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor det er vigtigt, at vores medarbejdere oplever balance mellem arbejdstid og fritid – så mener vi det altså. Vores fikstid er kl. 9-14 (kl. 10-14 om mandagen). Det er her, vi forventer, at du er tilgængelig og arbejder. Hvis du arbejder mere end dine 37 timer, så opsparer du fleks. Den kan du afvikle enten ved hele eller halve fleksdage eller f.eks. ved kortere arbejdsdage i en periode. Generelt har du god mulighed for selv at planlægge og administrere din arbejdsdag, og du kan arbejde hjemme i 2 dage om ugen, hvis dine opgaver tillader det. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der rummer medarbejdere i forskellige livsfaser. Derfor giver vi dig mulighed for tilpassede arbejdstider, orlov, flexjob, plustid og nedsat tid, hvis det er det, du har brug for.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold

Stillingen er en fast stilling på 37 timer. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til overenskomst mellem staten og Akademikernes Centralorganisation eller anden relevant overenskomst. Ansættelse og aflønning sker som fuldmægtig med rådighedsforpligtelse eller specialkonsulent i henhold til AC-overenskomsten. Den endelige løn fastsættes på baggrund af dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer. Ud over basislønnen kommer pension i henhold til overenskomsten samt eventuelle lokale tillæg. Det er en betingelse for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til klassifikationsgraden HEMMELIG og kan opretholde godkendelsen under hele ansættelsen.

Lyst til at vide mere?

Kontakt kontorchef Nihad Hodzic på 4178 0069, hvis du vil høre mere om jobbet og vores kommende AI Lab. Har du spørgsmål om ansættelsesvilkår eller Trafikstyrelsen som arbejdsplads, kan du kontakte HR-Konsulent Natasja Gerval Brabo på Nagbr@trafikstyrelsen.dk.

Vil du være en del af Trafikstyrelsen?

Søg stillingen senest den 29. oktober ved at trykke på ”Ansøg nu”. Der kan indgå test eller case i rekrutteringsforløbet. Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 45 og 46. Stillingen ønskes besat pr. 1. januar eller hurtigst muligt derefter.

Title: AI-udvikler søges til Dansk Center for Partikelterapi, AUH
Description:
AI-udvikler søges til Dansk Center for Partikelterapi, AUH,

Dansk Center for Partikelterapi (DCPT) søger en fysiker, hospitalsfysiker, datalog, softwareingeniør eller lignende profil til softwareudvikling inden for adaptiv protonterapi. DCPT er et nationalt center, der giver strålebehandling med protonterapi. Vores mission er at levere protonterapi af højest mulig kvalitet til alle relevante danske kræftpatienter. Alle vores udviklingsopgaver er forankret i brede tværfaglige, lokale, nationale og/eller internationale udviklings- og forskningsgrupper.

I denne nyoprettede stilling er der fokus på at løse de kliniske behov bl.a. gennem forskning, som bliver en vigtig del af din dagligdag. Du vil blive tilknyttet gruppen af fysikere og dosimetrister, hvis driftsopgave er at planlægge individuelle protonbehandlinger og kvalitetssikre behandlinger og tilhørende udstyr. Gruppen udvikler behandlingsteknikker i tæt samarbejde med læger, sygeplejersker, radiografer, m.fl., samt de ansatte i vores forskningsafdeling. DCPT har udviklet kunstig intelligens til at forbedre billedkvaliteten af de billeder vi anvender til at adaptere patientbehandlingen, samt til segmentering af medicinske billeder. Vi ønsker at styrke denne indsats og målrette den mod udviklingen af adaptiv protonterapi, hvor den individuelle tilpasning af behandlingen sker hurtigere og på daglig basis.

Det er afgørende, at du har følgende kompetencer


solid erfaring med maskinlæring og deep learning anvendt på billeddata - gerne 3D medicinsk billedbehandling: segmentering, registrering eller billede-til-billede-modeller
rutine i PyTorch eller tilsvarende, og erfaring med at træne, evaluere og fejlsøge modeller på virkelige datasæt
håndværksmæssig disciplin i kodning: versionsstyring, test, dokumentation og kodegennemgang. Du skal kunne bygge noget, som andre end dig selv kan overtage og videreudvikle
evnen til at arbejde tæt sammen med fysikere og klinikere, og til at sætte dig ind i et domæne du ikke selv er uddannet i.


Derudover er det en fordel, hvis du har


kendskab til medicinsk billedbehandling i praksis: DICOM og DICOM-RT, strålebehandlingsplanlægning, scripting mod et planlægningssystem
erfaring med at drifte modeller i produktion: containere, inferensservere, versionering af modeller og data og overvågning
serverdrift og databaser
kendskab til softwareudvikling under EU's forordning om medicinsk udstyr, herunder undtagelsen for egenudviklet software, samt kvalitetssystemer, risikostyring og validering
baggrund som fysiker eller erfaring fra stråleterapi.


Med ansættelse ved DCPT skal du være indstillet på at kunne brede dig ud over flere forskelligartede opgaver, der vil veksle mellem udviklingsopgaver og driftsorienterede opgaver. Din opgave- og projektportefølje vil udvikle sig over tid, og afhængigt af dine kompetencer vil den komme til at indeholde forskning, udvikling og drift.

Uanset hvor vægten kommer til at ligge, skal du


konstruktivt, effektivt og aktivt kunne indgå i samarbejder med forskere og klinikere
kunne sætte dig ind i brugeres og domænets behov
være ambitiøs og have lyst til at fuldføre dit arbejde med både praktiske og akademiske resultater
være indstillet på at løse mangeartede opgaver.


Det forventes, at du i samarbejde med DCPT's øvrige akademiske medarbejdere deltager aktivt i forsknings- og udviklingsopgaver. Du kommer til at indgå i et tværfagligt miljø med fysikere, læger, sygeplejersker, radiografer og andre, der ligeledes arbejder for at udvikle teknologi og klinisk udnyttelse af protonterapi. Er du kandidat, der opfylder indgangskrav til uddannelse som hospitalsfysiker, så vil centeret tilbyde dig uddannelsen. Hvis ikke, vil vi tilbyde lignende skræddersyet uddannelse og træning.

For yderligere information om stillingerne kontakt hospitalsfysiker, lektor Jesper Kallehauge på mail jespkall@rm.dk eller cheffysiker Ole Nørrevang på tlf. 2117 4193. Bemærk at Jesper Kallehauge ikke er tilgængelig for yderligere information før efter den 27. oktober.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Job Description

The Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI) opens a 4 year full time position for an experienced scientist to work with satellite and in-situ observations to assess the suitability of hybrid-ML/AI and end-to-end data-driven methods to replace classical (physics based) methods in the production of future reanalyses (e.g. ERA7)

Most of the work is carried out in the Horizon Europe project, CHERRI, led by European Center for Medium Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF). DMI has a task in the project to lead the activities about evaluating atmospheric reanalysis systems with a particular focus on oceans and the high latitudes, including ice sheets and sea ice. It is expected that you will be the technical and scientific lead on these activities that include developing a system which enables easy assessment of various NWP reanalysis products and on interpreting on the results to provide feedback to the model developers in CHERRI. DMI is a leading European developer and producer of remote sensing products, including surface temperature products for the global ocean and high latitudes, sea ice concentration and emissivity products for the Polar Oceans and you will use these products in the assessment.

In addition, you will participate in the work within the Copernicus Marine Service and the Copernicus Climate Change projects to produce operational and timely updates of the satellite surface temperature products.

You will work in close collaboration with dedicated and highly qualified colleagues in the remote sensing group and colleagues from other institutions across Europe and you will be writing peer reviewed publications and representing DMI in new research projects and in international organizations.

Main working tasks


Lead the tehnical and scientific development within the HEU CHERRI WP 9 “Work on NWP reanalysis model evaluation and diagnostics”
Develop diagnostics to assess the ability of hybrid-ML and end-to-end data-driven analysis methods to produce physically consistent earth-system states and trends.

Description:
To Good To Go: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Marketing Personalisation

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Hybrid)

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

We’re more than an app: we are a social impact company with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste. So alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 127 million registered users and 253,000 active partners across 20 countries, have together already prevented 489+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.322.000 tonnes of CO2e!

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to be a part of our Consumer Growth Product and Tech team that defines, builds, and delivers AI features for our marketing personalization efforts. You will work towards specific outcomes with the freedom and responsibility to figure out the best route to achieve them, collaborating with other engineers, data scientists, and product members. Within the Product & Tech organization, you will work toward generating the smartest possible recommendations for our users. Your work will ensure they are matched with the best meals at the right time, which in turn will result in more meals saved and improved user retention.

Your Mission

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of a team dedicated to delivering a step-change in personalization for our consumer marketplace. You will of course collaborate with your counterparts in other product teams, and will be part of the broader ML and tech communities at Too Good To Go. Your work will directly impact millions of users by improving our surplus food management solutions and personalizing their experience.

Tech Stack

Our models are written in Python, supported by SQL to retrieve data. Our models are built, evaluated, and productionised using our MLOps team's platform, which is based on Metaflow. The full Machine Learning stack includes: GitHub, Jenkins, Docker, Airflow, OpenSearch, and Redshift.

Responsibilities


Working on researching, building, and designing different machine-learning models for marketing personalization.
Running experiments, evaluating, and using the results to improve machine learning models and algorithms.
Working end-to-end to solve problems with a product and customer-oriented mindset.
Building and deploying models in production.
Involvement in developing statistical models.
Collaborating with the rest of the team to improve our product and solve customer problems.


The Ideal Candidate


Has established experience within a similar role.
Experience using Python and deploying to production.
First-hand experience with ML libraries, frameworks, and tools, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Prophet, DeepAR, etc.
Degree educated within a technical field (Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree).
Experience in a cloud environment (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Bonus: experience with dbt, Snowflake, Airflow, or Metaflow; experience in complex ML system design; and experience in statistical hypothesis testing.


What We Offer


Develop and maintain the backbone of our personalization engine, which is used by millions of users every day to support their efforts to combat food waste.
An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral member of our defined product teams. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the product scope and development; your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop, and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 20 countries.


Our values


We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We can do it if we win together as Waste Warriors with no ego. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers, and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving and want it to last.
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.


How To Apply


We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above.
Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
Please submit your CV and Cover letter in English.
Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Wildfire
Description:
Role & Team

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer at Overstory, you will lead the development and scaling of our Wildfire Fuel Detection Model. This core engine powers how we understand vegetation structure, fuel loads, and wildfire risk from satellite and environmental data. You’ll help shape the next generation of Overstory’s modeling capabilities by combining cutting-edge ML techniques, large-scale geospatial data, and real-world domain expertise.

Reporting to our VP of Product Engineering, you’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to ensure our wildfire models are accurate, robust, and production-ready – balancing scientific rigor with practical engineering excellence. As a senior technical leader, you’ll mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and define standards for modeling, experimentation, and deployment across Overstory.

Time zone requirement: Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST)

What You’ll Do

In collaboration with data, ML, and science colleagues, you will:


Architect and build advanced ML models to map and predict vegetation and fuel conditions across diverse geographies.
Design and maintain robust data and feature pipelines for large-scale geospatial and temporal data.
Partner with wildfire science and product teams to define modeling objectives and evaluation metrics tied to real-world impact.
Build reproducible experimentation frameworks and model evaluation workflows.
Scale models from research to production with a focus on performance, reliability, and explainability.
Lead the evolution of ML systems, tooling, and processes — ensuring that our wildfire fuelscape models remain state-of-the-art and maintainable.
Collaborate with MLOps peers to streamline training, inference, and monitoring in production environments.


Skills & Experience


Experience thriving at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and environmental science; deeply motivated by the opportunity to reduce wildfire risk through data-driven insights
10+ years of experience designing and building production-grade ML pipelines and systems
You have a background in wildfire science, forestry, or remote sensing
Strong background in deep learning, computer vision, or remote sensing
Skilled in designing end-to-end ML systems — from data ingestion and preprocessing to deployment and monitoring
Hands-on experience with frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, XGBoost, or LightGBM, and data tools like Dask, Spark, or GeoPandas
Familiarity with GCP and Vertex AI, or similar cloud-based ML platforms
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and scientific domains
Comfortable leading architectural discussions and mentoring other engineers


Nice To Have


Background in wildfire science, forestry, or remote sensing
Experience integrating physics-based models with ML or working with active learning and uncertainty quantification
Experience in model interpretability and data provenance for environmental ML systems
Experience with deep learning models for weather or climate data
Experience in remote-first or globally distributed teams


Note: We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.

What We Offer


Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits
Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around
Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets
A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values
To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis

Description:
Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that’s energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels, whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently – we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it and mend it.

About your team:

At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. We’re a global renewable energy trading company which helps move energy from source to use – powering businesses, homes, and societies as they transition to a new sustainable energy future. If the idea of working to create a sustainable energy future also moves you, we may very well be the right place for you.

If you enjoy a high-impact working environment at the forefront of the markets, while seeing your algorithms go from a first spark to actively trading in a matter of weeks, you might be the Quant Trader we are looking for to join us in the Algorithmic Trading team.

The role

Your role as Quant Trader will challenge your creative and technical abilities, working across all aspects of algorithmic trading — from data exploration and research to backtesting, implementation, deployment, and monitoring.

On an average workday, your principal responsibilities will include:


Conducting research, development and validation of trading strategies in short-term power markets across Europe and North America
Collaborating with the team in the creative process around inventing new algo trading concepts by sharing and refining trading ideas together
Developing and maintaining tools that our algorithmic trading operations
Monitoring and maintaining live trading strategies


With other Quant Traders, Algo Developers, and traders, you will be responsible for monetizing the aforementioned business areas via algorithmic trading, with clear profit objectives.

This role is based out of one of our locations in Denmark: Copenhagen or Aalborg.

The team

We are a cross-disciplinary commercial team consisting of top-level people with diverse quantitative backgrounds, such as mathematicians, physicists, software engineers and computer scientists. We share a mission of spearheading research, development, deployment, and operation of trading algorithms within energy commodity markets.

If you are curious, inventive, and open-minded, we are certain you will thrive with us, where discussing at a white-board and sharing trading ideas is equally important to your skills as a first-class Quant. We foster an open, collaborative workspace where continuous learning and professional growth aren’t just encouraged — they’re essential to staying sharp and competitive in the markets.

Your Qualifications

The ideal candidate has at least a few years of relevant experience. We expect you to hold a master’s degree or higher in mathematics, physics, or a closely related field.

Furthermore, we expect that you:


Are talented and passionate about data science and/or quantitative modelling
Have a strong interest in trading
Bring a commercial mindset and the confidence to take your models to the market
Approach problems with curiosity, creativity, and an innovative spirit
Embrace challenges and excel at developing original solutions
Are an experienced user of Python or R
Thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
Have good communication skills in English


It will be an advantage if you have


Experience as a quant trader
Knowledge of short-term power markets in Europe or North America
Strong interest in coding


About Centrica Energy

We’re a profitable company that understands the necessity of investment to achieve improvement. If you’ve got the willingness, ambitions, and right attitude we offer a work environment that will help you grow on a professional as well as personal level.

Energy markets are increasingly dominated by an ambitious decarbonization agenda, and so are we. Leveraging our in-house talent and specialists, extensive market expertise, technical capabilities, and the strong balance sheet of Centrica plc, we’re focused on delivering on the net-zero agenda as a vital enabler of our future growth. Our ambition is to become Europe’s No. 1 renewable energy trader and a globally important player, and we’re delivering on an ambitious corporate- and commercial strategy to make those ambitions a reality. Our work culture is flexible, entrepreneurial, and collaborative, marked by a high pace and equally high ambitions, but also emphasizing social engagement and having fun.

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. Role: Associate – Data Analyst

Locations: Copenhagen, Denmark | Hybrid 6 days a month

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Associate Data Analyst to join our Copenhagen office and become part of a specialised, collaborative, and close-knit team working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and securities litigation.

As an Associate, you will contribute to a broad range of research and analytical activities, including evaluating securities class actions, estimating potential investor recoveries, analysing settlement opportunities, and supporting the identification and assessment of new business opportunities.

The position combines financial analysis, data analysis, litigation research, and business research. You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.

You will be given hands-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data-driven financial analysis.

Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.

Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client-facing analytics.
Maintain and update internal databases and analytical tools relating to pending litigation, settlements, and institutional investors.
Prepare tables, charts, calculations, and other analytical materials using Microsoft Excel and other data-analysis tools.
Perform ad hoc financial, litigation, and business research as required.
Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.


What You Will Bring:

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.


A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Law, or another relevant field.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.


The following would be an advantage but is not required:


Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data-analysis or statistical software.
Experience in financial analysis, investment research, data analytics, business research, or a related area.
Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.

Title: AI/ML Engineer
Description:
The fastest-growing European SaaS company is searching for a Senior AI/ML Engineer!




⚠️ Before you apply:

We consider candidates based in Europe only.

We require real 3D CV experience — meaning actual project work, not just listed skills. If 3D CV does not appear in your actual work history, this role is not for you.

Applications that don't meet these criteria will be automatically rejected and may limit your eligibility for other DocuSketch roles.




About DocuSketch:

DocuSketch, with its European Headquarters in Potsdam, Germany, is a leading European software technology provider for the digital real estate economy. With our product brands Immoviewer and DocuSketch, we have become one of the most successful and fastest-growing software vendors in the rapidly expanding property tech sector. Our enthusiastic customer base is located across Europe and North America. DocuSketch's groundbreaking digital technology greatly facilitates real estate companies and building restoration companies in digitizing, visualizing, and virtualizing real estate properties. Our solutions help our clients realize tremendous cost-saving potential, process optimization, and revenue growth.




You’ll be working in a team that drives the company's AI development to develop algorithms for a variety of different use cases. This includes, e.g., working with equirectangular, phone, or satellite images to detect doors, windows, or other objects inside buildings or finding facets on the roof. You’ll be challenged by solving complex 3D geometry problems and working closely with our labeling team to ensure the best possible data quality.




Responsibilities and Duties

· Research, train and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models for object detection and 3D perception on equirectangular images

· Quickly prototype new ideas/technologies to create proof of concept and demos




Qualifications

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

· Excellent math skills

· Experience with 3D computer vision algorithms

· Preferably 5+ years of experience developing and training machine learning models

· Strong Experience with Deep ML frameworks (PyTorch)

· Strong Experience in Python

· Self-motivated and energetic team player with a strong work ethic and cooperative attitude

· Excellent communication and organizational skills




Plus

· Familiarity with building big data systems

· Training very large models using multiple GPUs in the cloud

· Experience with training machine learning models on equirectangular images




We are seeking a performance-driven, high-energy personality who has several years of experience in the field. Since you will work intensely with teams from many countries, a solid command of the English language is a prerequisite. We offer attractive compensation, unlimited career opportunities, and the possibility to work in one of the most exciting software companies in the industry. The position will be remote in any location of your choice in Europe (outside Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine). Our headquarters are in Berlin, Germany, with major offices in Belgrade, Serbia, Lakeland, Florida, and in Canada.




We look forward to receiving your application!

Title: Quantitative Developer
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Join us in this role where you’ll ensure accurate and stable daily calculations for our gas portfolio. You’ll analyse and explain market-to-market values and risk metrics, helping colleagues understand portfolio performance and make well-informed commercial decisions.

Welcome to Structuring & Analysis

You’ll be part of Structuring & Analysis where you, together with your colleagues, will provide quantitative analysis and reliable calculations for the gas portfolio. You’ll work close to the trading business, and risk management colleagues, connecting technical results with daily commercial decisions.

As a team, we share knowledge, support each other, and take pride in delivering clear, dependable insights in a fast-moving environment.

You’ll play an important role in:


ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and operational stability of end-of-day calculations for the gas portfolio
analysing and explaining the market-to-market value of the portfolio and the factors driving changes
connecting portfolio results with risk metrics and explaining the calculations used in risk reporting
supporting the gas portfolio with day-to-day quantitative analysis and timely investigation of results
acting as a point of contact between the gas portfolio and development colleagues to improve tools and calculations
identifying opportunities to strengthen calculation processes, controls, and analytical quality.


To succeed in the role, you:


have a master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, finance, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience
apply mathematical and statistical knowledge to practical business questions and can investigate results with accuracy and attention to detail
have programming experience and can work confidently with financial domain specific languages, quantitative models, and calculation tools
communicate complex technical concepts clearly and patiently to both technical and non-technical colleagues
work well with stakeholders in a fast-moving environment, respond constructively when priorities change, and take ownership of issues
have knowledge of European gas markets or experience in a desk quant, trading, portfolio, or risk environment, or are motivated to develop this knowledge.


Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

 

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

 

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

 

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr51,440.00- kr77,160.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our benefits package:

For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

Pre-employment background check:

Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Title: Working in power markets? Let's talk
Place: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Electricity Maps is building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. Real-time, historical, and forecasted electricity mix, prices, load, and carbon intensity across markets worldwide.

Power markets are a wide, fast-moving space and one with a lot of room for someone with the right experience to help shape what direction we take. That's why we'd rather meet you now even if we don't have an official role on the page. From there, we can figure out together what makes sense. We especially love hearing from people who come with a view: where you'd add value, what you'd want to work on or what you think we're missing.

Maybe you work in one of the following areas:


Day-ahead and intraday forecasting
BESS and asset optimization
Imbalance and balancing markets
Renewable generation forecasting (wind, solar, etc.)
Power market analytics or trading
Something adjacent


We're interested in talking across all lines of work in these areas: Engineering, ML, product, commercial, analytics, or something else. Whatever angle you come at it from, we're curious to hear it.

What to expect

We read every intro that comes through. If we see something we want to learn more about, we'll reach out to get to know each other and figure out together where your experience could add the most value.

About Electricity Maps

There are two sides to what we do. The first: decarbonizing the grid by making historical, real-time, and forecasted data on electricity mix, load, and carbon intensity available to anyone making smarter decisions across the energy transition.

The second is newer for us - we've started working with energy traders, asset operators, and BESS players in European power markets, building out price forecasting, market signals, and adjacent tooling. It's an area we're growing fast in and one with plenty of room for the right person to help shape where it goes.

The details


Location: Copenhagen (in-office with flexibility)
Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options (when a role materializes)
Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at office

Title: Senior Manager, Biostatistics
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

The Senior Manager, Biostatistics acts as a biostatistician supporting the clinical development of compounds as compound lead, primarily up until proof of concept, and/or as trial responsible statistician.

Responsibilities

Compound/Indication Level


Act as lead and main point of contact related to Statistics for designated compound/indication
Follow scientific and technical progress within the field of biostatistics in drug development and advise of new methodologies that may support innovation and improve efficiencies
Engage with regulatory authorities on compound/indication level discussions
Acts as a role model
Ensures consistency of statistical methods and data handling across trials
Ensures all compound/indication related work and information is shared between biostatisticians involved in the compound and with the vendor
Supports compound responsible programmer in developing an integrated database specification


CDT Member


Responsible for giving statistical input to overall strategy and the synopsis development in the CDT
Provide scientific advice to the CDT including design of trials, analyses and analyses requiring advanced statistical methodologies/techniques
Represent the CDT/the company at regulatory meetings, during Key Opinion Leaders meetings, network and/or Partner meetings, as applicable
Drive design and synopsis development together with relevant stakeholders
Ensure transparent communication to relevant stakeholders from the CDT
Ensure availability of integrated database(s), as needed, and planning and conduct of integrated analysis to support development decisions, submissions, and marketing needs
Support development and communication in relation to communication strategy and/or scientific input to presentations, posters, and articles


Trial Level


Represent Genmab during meetings/congresses and courses and perform professional networking
Engage with regulatory authorities on trial level discussions
Arranges/attends lessons learned to share learnings
Represents Genmab during Key Opinion Leaders meetings
Ensure biostatistician review of partner synopsis, protocols, statistical analysis plans, results meetings presentations and clinical trial reports
Coordinate data transfers from/to business partners in collaboration with the programmer and the data manager, as applicable


CTT Member


Participate and represent Biostatistics
Review and provide input to protocol and amendment development
Perform vendor oversight according to applicable SOPs
Give input to eCRF setup, edit checks, validation plan, protocol deviations classifications, DSUR, IB updates, tables, figures, and listings etc.
Review assay validation reports, as applicable
Perform exploratory analysis, ad hoc analyses, and modelling of data
Review and approve randomization and stratification plans
Perform UAT of Randomization part of the IRT system as applicable
Ensure procedures for blinding are in place as applicable
Support timely delivery of statistical deliverables
Responsible for planning and conducting trial result meetings
Review and approve the CSR
Attend operational and steering committee meetings, as applicable
Support regulatory submission/filing activities


Requirements


MS / PhD or equivalent in a statistical discipline
5+ years of experience in relevant area preferred or demonstrated capability
Experience in statistical analysis, modelling and simulation and adaptive trial designs
Experience in working with clinical trials
Preferred experience with oncology clinical trials
Proficient programming skills in statistical software’s, such as SAS
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Ability to work independently as well as in teams
Confident, self-reliant, and a quick learner
